you discover?

name: Potion
description:
Restores a small amount of
health.

Restores a moderate amount
of health.

description:
Very slightly increases
your maximum health level.

Slightly increases your
maximum health level.

description:
Removes all traces of poison
from your body.

Boosts your natural ability
to heal.

Lets you run without tiring
for a short period of time.

description:
Lets you run without tiring
for even longer than regular
Dash Juice.

name: Demondrug
description:
Boosts your attack by 
filling you with -guess
what?- demonic strength.

description:
Boosts your attack even
more than regular Demondrug.

name: Might Pill
description:
Temporarily endows you with
the strength of a mighty
god. Potent!

name: Armorskin
description:
Boosts defense by turning
your skin as hard as rock.

description:
Boosts your defense even 
more than regular 
Armourskin.

name: Adamant Pill
description:
Temporarily makes your skin
as hard as adamant. Potent!

name: Cool Drink
description:
Provides temporary relief
from extreme heat.

name: Hot Drink
description:
Provides temporary relief
from extreme cold.

Temporarily sharpens your 
sixth-sense, and attunes
you to the ways of monsters.

name: Monster Fluid
description:
A liquid bugs suck from
monsters. Mixes with gastric
juices to form adhesive.

name: Monster Broth
description:
A broth made of only the
thickest of monster juices.
Very rich.

name: Herbal Medicine
description:
Removes all traces of 
poison and restores a small
amount of health.

name: Max Potion
description:
Fully restores health and
maximizes the size of 
your health gauge.

name: Ancient Potion
description:
Fully restores health and
maximizes the size of your 
health and stamina gauge.

name: Catalyst
description:
Enhances the effects of
other materials, but cannot
be used on its own.

name: Energy Drink
description:
A Guild-approved beverage
that boosts Stamina. Helps
shake off Sleep too!

name: Gunpowder
description:
A volatile substance that
explodes when struck or
heated.

name: Lifecrystals
description:
Mysterious crystals long
worshipped as a source of
life.

name: Lifepowder
description:
Medicine made of compounded
Lifecrystals. Heals those
nearby with a single touch.

name: Powercharm
description:
An amulet that raises your
Attack. Just carrying it
gives you demonic strength.

name: Powertalon
description:
A powerful amulet that
raises Attack. Made with
a Lao-Shan Claw.

name: Armorcharm
description:
An amulet that raises your
Defense. Just carrying this
hardens your skin.

name: Armortalon
description:
A powerful amulet that
raises Defense. Made with
a Lao-Shan Claw.

name: Tranquilizer
description:
Medicine that works as an
anesthetic when combined.

name: Raw Meat
description:
Meat carved from a monster.
Can be cooked, combined, or
used to set a trap.

name: Oiled Meat
description:
Raw meat basted with a
fragrant oil that'll make
anyone's mouth water.

name: Spiced Meat
description:
Raw meat basted with a
spicy rub that'll make
anyone's mouth water.

name: Glazed Meat
description:
Raw meat basted with a
refreshing, yet sweet glaze.
Makes anyone's mouth water.

name: Poisoned Meat
description:
Raw meat that poisons
anything that eats it.
Great bait for traps.

name: Tinged Meat
description:
Raw meat that paralyzes
anything that eats it.
Great bait for traps.

name: Drugged Meat
description:
Raw meat that causes sleep
in anything that eats it.
Great bait for traps.

name: Rare Steak
description:
Provides a small boost to
your stamina. This one's
still red in the middle.

name: Well-done Steak
description:
Provides a moderate boost 
to your stamina. Packed
with juicy goodness.

name: Gourmet Steak
description:
The pinnacle of steaks.
So juicy and crisp it'll
boost your full Stamina.

name: Burnt Meat
description:
Meat that has been burnt to
a crisp. It might boost your
Stamina, or it might not...

name: Hot Meat
description:
Meat that warms the body
and provides temporary
relief from extreme cold.

name: Hot Meat+
description:
Provides temporary relief
from the cold and restores
a small amount of Stamina.

name: Chilled Meat
description:
Meat that cools the body
and provides temporary
relief from extreme heat.

name: Chilled Meat+
description:
Provides temporary relief
from the heat and restores
a small amount of Stamina.

name: Antidote Meat
description:
Antidotal meat that removes
Poison from your system.

name: Antidote Meat+
description:
Antidotal meat that removes
Poison from your system and
recovers some Stamina.

name: Rare Fish
description:
While not fully cooked, it
will still restore Stamina.

name: Well-done Fish
description:
A crispy grilled fish that
improves natural healing
and restores Stamina.

name: Well-done Fish+
description:
High-quality grilled fish.
Boosts natural recovery and 
Stamina.

name: Gourmet Fish
description:
Fish grilled to perfection.
Boosts natural recovery and
Stamina.

name: Gourmet Fish+
description:
A large fish grilled to
perfection. Boosts natural
recovery and Stamina.

name: Burnt Fish
description:
Charred fish. Eating it will
still recover some Stamina.

name: （ダミー）
description: ダミー。

name: Boomerang
description:
An unusually-shaped weapon
from abroad that returns to
its user when thrown.

name: Throwing Knife
description:
A standard throwing knife.
Flies straight and true.
~C05(Supply Item)~C00

name: Poison Knife
description:
A throwing knife with a
venom-coated blade. Poisons
targets. ~C05(Supply Item)~C00

name: Sleep Knife
description:
A throwing knife that has
been dusted with sleeping
agents. ~C05(Supply Item)~C00

name: Paralysis Knife
description:
A throwing knife coated
with toxins that paralyze
a target. ~C05(Supply Item)~C00

name: Tranq Knife
description:
A throwing knife used to
capture monsters ensnared
in traps. ~C05(Supply Item)~C00

name: Bomb Casing
description:
A base material for making
hand-thrown bombs.

name: Paintball
description:
Toss this scented paint at a 
monster to mark it, allowing
you to track its position.

name: Flash Bomb
description:
Flashes brightly on impact.
Toss this right under a
monster's nose to blind it.

name: Sonic Bomb
description:
A grenade-like item that
emits a high-frequency blast
of sound on detonation.

name: Dung
description:
That's right: monster poop.
The odor reveals (too) much
about a monster's diet.

name: Dung Bomb
description:
When thrown, releases a
strong odor which certain
monsters find repulsive.

name: Smoke Bomb
description:
Creates a large cloud of
smoke wherever it lands.

name: Psn Smoke Bomb
description:
Contains a toxic chemical.
Also popular as a household
bug bomb.

name: Farcaster
description:
Instantly transports you
back to base camp.

name: Deodorant
description:
An item that cures Stench.
Releases deodorizing smoke
when thrown down.

name: Tranq Bomb
description:
A hand-thrown bomb used to
capture monsters ensnared in
traps.

name: Spider Web
description: A very sticky web.

name: Net
description:
A sturdy net able to support
a certain amount of weight
without breaking.

name: Trap Tool
description:
A must-have item for putting
together Pitfall Traps and
other kinds of traps.

name: Pitfall Trap
description:
A trap for catching certain
large monsters. Tripped by
heavy weight.

name: Shock Trap
description:
A trap that immobilizes a
target. Use it to capture
monsters.

name: Lightning Rod
description:
A device used to attract
lightning during storms.

description: ダミー。

description:
A small barrel lid. There
appears to be a drawing on
it.

name: Small Barrel
description: A small, empty barrel.

name: Large Barrel
description: A large, empty barrel.

name: Barrel Bomb S
description: A small time-bomb.

name: Barrel Bomb S+
description:
Upgraded Small Barrel Bomb.
Despite its size, it packs
a strong punch.

name: Barrel Bomb L
description:
Powerful bomb triggered by
external, physical impact.

name: Barrel Bomb L+
description:
Upgraded Large Barrel Bomb.
Effective against large
monsters.

description:
Launches into the air when
set. This modified bomb
requires skill to use.

name: Bounce Bomb+
description:
An improved version of the
Bounce Bomb. Requires some
skill to use.

name: Anti-Dragon Bomb
description:
A small time bomb designed
to stick directly to large
targets. ~C05(Supply Item)~C00

【ＣＴアイテム】
イベント用爆弾

name: Huskberry
description:
A berry that is hollow on
the inside. Tough enough to
grow just about anywhere.

name: Bone Husk S
description:
Used as a bone ammo casing.
Produces sturdier results
than a Huskberry.

name: Bone Husk L
description:
Ammo casing made from large
wyvern bones. Produces even
sturdier results.

Ammo for novices. Cheap, but
don't expect much. Unlimited
shots.

name: Normal S Lv2
description:
Non-specialized ammo. More
powerful than Lv1.
Capacity: 99

name: Normal S Lv3
description:
Non-specialized ammo. More
powerful than Lv2.
Capacity: 99

description:
Armor-piercing ammo that
deals multiple hits to some
monsters. Capacity: 60

description:
High-grade armor-piercing
ammo. Deals more hits than
Lv1. Capacity: 50

name: Pierce S Lv3
description:
Max-grade armor-piercing
ammo. Deals numerous hits.
Capacity: 40

name: Pellet S Lv1
description:
Ammo that spreads out to
cover a wide area.
Capacity: 60

name: Pellet S Lv2
description:
Ammo that covers a wide 
area. Deals more hits than
Lv1. Capacity: 60

name: Pellet S Lv3
description:
Max-grade ammo that covers
a wide area. Deals numerous
hits. Capacity: 60

Ammo that lodges in a target
and explodes. Also deals
Stun. Capacity: 9

name: Crag S Lv2

Powerful ammo that lodges
in a target and explodes.
Also stuns. Capacity: 9

name: Crag S Lv3
description:
Devastating ammo that lodges
in a target and explodes.
Also stuns. Capacity: 9

description:
Ammo that divides into three
shells upon impact. Beware
friendly fire! Capacity: 3

name: Clust S Lv2
description:
Ammo that divides into four
shells upon impact. Beware
friendly fire! Capacity: 3

name: Clust S Lv3
description:
Ammo that divides into five
shells upon impact. Beware
friendly fire! Capacity: 3

Ammo that packs an extra
punch against enemies weak
to Fire. Capacity: 60

name: Water S

Ammo that packs an extra
punch against enemies weak
to Water. Capacity: 60

name: Thunder S
description:
Ammo that packs an extra
punch against enemies weak
to Thunder. Capacity: 60

name: Freeze S
description:
Ammo that packs an extra
punch against enemies weak
to Ice. Capacity: 60

name: Dragon S

Mysterious ammo that won't
work in normal Bowguns.
 Capacity: 20

Ammo that restores a small
amount of health to an ally
upon impact. Capacity: 12

name: Recover S Lv2
description:
Ammo that restores a medium
amount of health to an ally
upon impact. Capacity: 12

name: Poison S Lv1
description:
Poisons target, but may
require several shots.
Capacity: 12

name: Poison S Lv2

Enhanced ammo that inflicts
Poison. May require several
shots. Capacity: 8

name: Para S Lv1
description:
Paralyzes target, but may
require several shots.
Capacity: 12

name: Para S Lv2
description:
Enhanced ammo that inflicts
Paralysis. May require 
several shots. Capacity: 8

name: Sleep S Lv1
description:
Ammo that induces Sleep.
Some targets may require
multiple shots. Capacity: 12

name: Sleep S Lv2
description:
Enhanced ammo that inflicts
Sleep. May require several
shots. Capacity: 8

name: Tranq S
description:
Bowgun ammo used to capture
monsters ensnared in traps.  Capacity: 8

name: Paint S
description:
Ammo that marks a monsters
position on the map for a
limited time. Capacity: 99

name: Demon S
description:
Ammo that fills the target
with savage amounts of 
strength. Capacity: 5

name: Armor S
description:
Ammo that makes the targets
skin as hard as stone.
Capacity: 5

An energetic insect that is
popular as fishing bait.

Often used as a fishing 
lure. Entices those fishies
to bite.

description:
A glowing insect that makes
for a great fishing lure.

description:
A fishing lure. The ideal
bait for certain aquatic
monsters.

description:
A nugget-shaped fishing
lure that makes various
tunas go "mmm."

A nugget-shaped fishing
lure that makes Arowana
go "mmm."

name: Goldenfish Bait
description:
A nugget-shaped fishing
lure that makes Goldenfish
go "mmm".

A fly lure that causes a
feeding frenzy no matter
what fish is biting.

A cheap pickaxe with an
easily nicked blade.

description:
A pickaxe with a reasonably
strong blade.

description:
Pickaxe tempered with steel.
This one won't nick easily.

name: Old Bug Net
description:
A cheap net for catching
bugs. It tears easily.

description:
A durable net for catching
bugs.

name: Mega Bug Net
description:
An extremely durable net
for catching bugs. This
one is made to last.

name: BBQ Spit
description:
Just what you need to cook
meat. A must-have item for
any hungry hunter.

description:
Cooks faster than a normal
BBQ Spit, but also requires
more skill to use.

name: Manly BBQ Spit
description:
A BBQ Spit tailored to the
discerning male hunter.
Makes grilling easy!

name: Ladies' BBQ Spit
description:
A BBQ Spit tailored to the
discerning female hunter.
Makes grilling fun!

name: Felyne BBQ Spit
description:
A BBQ Spit tailor-made for
Felynes. You wouldn't blame
them for failing, would you?

description:
An upgrade kit for a BBQ
Spit. Combine them to take
your grilling to the max.

description:
A versatile BBQ Spit. Try
combining it with the item
you want to cook!

name: Meat BBQ
description:
A versatile BBQ Spit lined
with Raw Meat. All that's
left is to grill it!

name: Meat BBQ
description:
A versatile BBQ Spit lined
with Oiled Meat. All that's
left is to grill it!

name: Meat BBQ
description:
A versatile BBQ Spit lined
with Spiced Meat. All that's
left is to grill it!

name: Meat BBQ
description:
A versatile BBQ Spit lined
with Glazed Meat. All that's
left is to grill it!

name: Meat BBQ
description:
A versatile BBQ Spit lined
with Poisoned Meat. All that
is left is to grill it!

name: Fish BBQ
description:
A versatile BBQ Spit lined
with fish. All that's left
is to grill it!

name: Fish BBQ
description:
A versatile BBQ Spit lined
with a large fish. All that
is left is to grill it!

name: Whetstone
description:
A standard-sized Whetstone.
Use it to restore a weapon's
Sharpness.

name: Binoculars
description:
Allow you to see farther
and observe from a distance.

name: Garbage
description:
Junk created as a result of
a failed combination.

name: Field Horn
description:
Used to attract monsters --
blow at your own risk. May
break when used.

name: Health Horn
description:
A horn that restores Health
to those who hear it. May
break when used.

name: Antidote Horn
description:
Eliminates poison in the
blood of those who hear it.
May break when used.

name: Demon Horn
description:
Increases the strength of
those who hear it. May break
when used.

name: Armor Horn
description:
Bolsters the defenses of
those who hear it. May break
when used.

name: Honey
description:
Sweet, golden honey. High in
nutritional value.

name: Sunrise Herb
description:
A curious herb that can be
picked during the day. Used
in combinations.

name: Sunset Herb
description:
An aromatic herb that can
only be picked at night.
Used in combinations.

name: Herb
description:
A plant that restores a very
small amount of Health. Not
very flavorful.

name: Antidote Herb
description:
A plant used in antidotes.
It sometimes cures poison
when eaten by itself.

name: Fire Herb
description: A wondrous, flammable plant.

name: Ivy
description:
A lightweight and extremely
strong plant.

name: Sleep Herb
description:
A plant containing sleeping
agents.

name: Sap Plant
description:
A plant with leaves coated
in sticky sap. Difficult to
remove once attached.

name: Felvine
description:
Melynxes' favorite food --
they just have to steal it.

name: Cactus Flower
description:
Possesses antidotal agents,
but it will not work by
itself.

name: Blooming Cactus
description:
A mutated Cactus Flower.
Blooms in odd places.
~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Hot Pepper
description:
Blazingly spicy. It'll warm
you up, but it's too hot to
handle on its own.

name: Unique Mushroom
description:
A pinky-sized mushroom with
an unusual aroma. Beloved by
Mosswine. ~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Choice Mushroom
description:
The perfect shape and aroma.
Even better than a Unique
Mushroom. ~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Ripened Mushroom
description:
A Unique Mushroom made more
unique by maturing its aroma
and flavor. ~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Blue Mushroom
description:
Rare mushroom with a power-
enhancing effect.

name: Nitroshroom
description:
A hard-to-find mushroom with
the power to generate strong
heat.

name: Parashroom
description:
A mushroom that induces
paralysis.

name: Toadstool
description:
Logic says not to eat this
poisonous fungus, but don't
write it off completely.

name: Exciteshroom
description:
This one has a very strange
aroma... But is it edible?
Only one way to find out.

name: Mandragora
description:
A dangerous fungus said to
draw the life out of people.
Beware.

name: Spicy Mushroom
description:
A mushroom that restores a
small amount of Stamina.
~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Deadly Toadstool
description:
A strange mushroom found
only at night. It can't be
eaten on its own.

name: Prism Dandelion
description:
A pretty dandelion with
petals of various colors.
It's used for making dyes.

name: Paintberry
description:
A berry with a shocking hue
and an overwhelming scent.
Look out: it WILL stain!

name: Might Seed
description:
Temporarily raises your
Attack when ingested by
improving energy flow.

name: Adamant Seed
description:
Temporarily raises your
Defense when ingested by
hardening tissue.

name: Dragonfell Berry
description:
A mysterious berry, rumored
since ancient times to be
loathed by dragons.

name: Scatternut
description:
A nut that violently ejects
its contents when struck.

name: Needleberry
description:
A berry covered in needle-
like thorns. Used to craft
ammo.

name: Bomberry
description:
A berry that explodes when
stuck.

name: Broken Shell
description: A slightly damaged shell.

name: Black Pearl
description:
A pearl with a black glow.
Fetches a high price.

name: Sunstone
description:
An ore that glows dimly in
the sun, found during the
day. Has a variety of uses.

name: Stone
description: A small rock. Can be thrown.

name: Iron Ore
description:
Ore that can be smelted
into metal and used for
many different purposes.

name: Earth Crystal
description:
Crystallized microbes which
are prized as an abrasive
when forging weapons.

name: Machalite Ore
description:
An ore that yields better
metals than Iron Ore. Used
to make Machalite.

name: Dragonite Ore
description:
A rare, valuable ore that
yields metal superior to
that of Machalite.

name: Carbalite Ore
description:
An ore that is still being
researched. It yields even
better metal than Dragonite.

name: Fucium Ore
description:
A mysterious ore capable of
fusing nearly any materials
together.

name: Firestone
description:
A stone that combusts even
at room temperature. Used
to fuse materials together.

name: Coal
description:
A combustible rock that
emits a faint warmth.
~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Lightcrystal
description:
An extremely hard substance
with a faint glow. Sometimes
used for crafting tools.

name: Novacrystal
description:
A brightly glowing crystal.
Extremely hard, it's also
used to make armory tools.

name: Antiseptic Stone
description:
Combining an Earth Crystal
and insect nutrients creates
this. Not found in nature.

name: Ice Crystal
description:
Ice that will not melt at
room temperature. Can be
used to create denser ore.

name: （ダミー）
description: ダミー。

name: Great Hibiscus
description:
A large, beautifully colored
flowering plant foreign to
this land.

name: Ale Nuts
description:
Oily nuts often used in 
official Guild beverages.
They can stain the skin.

name: Anbar Ore
description:
Strange amber-colored ice
often found full of trapped
insects and plants.

name: Secret Stash
description:
A pouch carried by a Melynx.
Full of miscellaneous junk.
~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Whetfish

A fish with a dorsal fin
hard enough to be used to
sharpen weapons.

name: Sushifish
description:
A delicious, fatty fish.
Eating it recovers a small
amount of Health.

name: Sleepyfish
description:
A fish containing sleeping
agents.

name: Pin Tuna
description:
A fish with jaws covered in
tiny, needle-like spikes.

name: Popfish
description:
A fish that literally pops
when it dies.

name: Scatterfish
description:
A fish that splits into
little pieces when it dies.

name: Burst Arowana
description:
A fish that bursts open when
it dies.

name: Bomb Arowana
description:
A fish that explodes when
it dies.

name: Large Whetfish
description:
An enormous Whetfish. Its
sharp scales serve as even
better Whetstones.

name: Large Sleepyfish
description:
An enormous Sleepyfish.
Used to craft ammo.

name: Large Pin Tuna
description:
An enormous Pin Tuna.
Used to craft ammo.

name: Large Popfish
description:
An enormous Popfish.
Used to craft ammo.

name: Large Arowana
description:
An enormous Burst Arowana.
Used to craft ammo.

name: Glutton Tuna
description:
A fish that eats anything --
allowing you to sometimes
get items from its stomach.

name: Gastronome Tuna
description:
An enormous Glutton Tuna.
Will eat anything, no matter
the size.

name: Goldenfish
description:
A rare fish made of solid
gold. Sell it for a tidy
sum. ~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Speartuna
description:
A giant fish that's both
rare and valuable. Maybe it
could be used for something?

name: Small Goldenfish
description:
A small, rare, gold fish.
Commands a high price.

name: Platinumfish
description:
A rare fish made of solid
platinum. Sell it for a tidy
sum.

name: Ancient Fish
description:
A rare catch prized for its
every part. Whispers say it
might even make a fine meal.

name: Queen Shrimp
description:
A shrimp that once ruled as
queen. Known to occasionally
devour its mate.

name: Insect Husk
description:
The remains of a dead
insect.

name: Yambug
description:
Named for its shape. Make
fishing lures with it; its
scent drives Tunas wild.

name: Bughopper
description:
A roundish insect, whose
scent drives Arowana wild.
Try making lures with it.

name: Snakebee Larva
description:
An unusual larva. Its scent
drives Goldenfish wild. Try
making lures with it.

name: Godbug
description:
An insect said to live for
a thousand years.

name: Bitterbug
description:
A sharp-tasting bug with
innate healing abilities.
Eating it may cure Poison.

name: Flashbug
description:
An insect that emits a
powerful flash when it
dies.

name: Thunderbug
description:
An insect that emits
electricity when struck.
Has many applications.

name: King Scarab
description:
The royal class of the
scarabs, with a hard shell
and lustrous wings.

name: Glueglopper
description:
A cricket-like bug that
disgorges an extremely
powerful adhesive.

name: （ダミー）
description: ダミー。

name: Shiny Beetle
description:
An insect with dazzling
wings. Its hard shell is
often used as an abrasive.

name: Rare Scarab
description:
A rare and valuable insect
that greatly assists in the
bonding of metals.

name: Royal Rhino
description:
A beetle with a jewel-like
gleam that collectors pay
dearly for. ~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Jungle Onion
description:
Green onion found in the
Jungle. Hardy and wild.
Cooking ingredient.

name: Sliced Cactus
description:
A desert delicacy. Mind the
thorns! Cooking ingredient.

name: Rare Onion
description:
An onion so sweet, it won't
even make you cry. Cooking
ingredient.

name: Fatty Tomato
description:
Top-quality tomato. When
bitten, juice gushes out.
Cooking ingredient.

name: Demon Mushroom
description:
A hideous-looking mushroom
with a succulent flavor.
Cooking ingredient.

name: Woemill Wheat
description:
A tough grain that grows in
cold regions. Faintly sweet.
Cooking ingredient.

name: Mixed Beans
description:
An assortment of aromatic
beans. Cooking ingredient.

name: Hardtack
description:
Rock-hard bread, as the name
suggests. Bound to be a good
workout. Cooking ingredient.

name: Silver Ricegrass
description:
A plant with small rice-like
grains, and a silky texture.
Cooking ingredient.

name: Ancient Beans
description:
Nutritious beans that have
not changed for millenia.
Cooking ingredient.

name: White Liver
description:
A white liver, popular for
its juicy texture. Cooking
ingredient.

name: Popo Tongue
description:
Popo tongues are popular,
healthy, and fun to eat. 
Cooking ingredient.

name: Pickled Khezu
description:
A Khezu larva, pickled in
brine. Tickles the tongue.
Cooking ingredient.

name: Remobra Shank
description:
Ribs from a Remobra that
are... an acquired taste.
Cooking ingredient.

name: Dragon Tail
description:
A popular cut of meat from
a flying wyvern. Cooking
ingredient.

name: Scalefish
description:
A musical-note shaped fish.
Its taste is unremarkable.
Cooking ingredient.

name: Snake Salmon
description:
A lively fish that wriggles
just like a snake. Cooking
ingredient.

name: Ricebug
description:
A sweet-tasting insect that
is no bigger than a grain of
rice. Cooking ingredient.

name: Spicy Worm
description:
An insect with a slightly
spicy taste. Beloved as a
snack. Cooking ingredient.

name: Honey Dragonfly
description:
Native to Kokoto, its taste
is strangely nostalgic.
Cooking ingredient.

name: Hercudrome
description:
Said to be the world's
strongest bug. Used in
forging and other things.

name: Red Oil
description:
A blazing-hot oil that will
light a fire in any dish!
Cooking ingredient.

name: Powerlard
description:
Nourishing, belly-filling
fat. Cooking ingredient.

name: Lifejam
description:
A jam widely considered to
improve longevity. Cooking
ingredient.

name: Dry Margarine
description:
A straightforward part of
any tasty and filling dish.
Cooking ingredient.

name: Buffalo Butter
description:
Butter made from the milk of
a temperamental cow. Cooking
ingredient.

name: Royal Cheese
description:
Luxuriously rich cheese.
Commands a high price.
Cooking ingredient.

name: Hopi
description:
Just a sip makes you tipsy.
The people's pour! Cooking
ingredient.

name: Blessed Wine
description:
The finest of wines found
across the land. "A must
try for everyone."

name: Golden Ale
description:
An incredibly rare brew.
The king of all drinks.
Cooking ingredient.

name: Monster Egg
description:
It looks like a monster egg,
but has an eerie color.
Cooking ingredient.

name: Poogie Crackers
description:
A Poogie favorite. Once
they spot one, they'll
come running!

name: （ダミー）
description: ダミー。

name: Screamer Sac
description:
A monster organ that emits
an earsplitting sonic blast
when ruptured.

name: Poison Sac
description:
A monster organ filled with
a lethal toxin. Handle with
extreme care.

name: Paralysis Sac
description:
A monster organ filled with
paralyzing neurotoxins.

name: （ダミー）
description: ダミー。

name: Sleep Sac
description:
A monster organ filled with
a knockout powder capable of
inducing Sleep.

name: （ダミー）
description: ダミー。

name: Flame Sac
description:
A monster organ filled with
a flammable powder. Handle
with extreme care.

name: Electro Sac
description:
A monster organ that can
store up electricity, which
is released on impact.

name: Dash Extract
description:
A Gypceros body fluid. The
secret behind its limitless
stamina.

name: Pale Extract
description:
A Khezu body fluid capable
of amplifying the effects of
certain medicines.

name: Monster Bone S
Monster Bone M
description:
A nicely-sized bone. Strong
yet flexible. As reliable as
steel and wood.

name: Monster Bone L
description:
Wyvern bone needed to craft
larger items. The right item
will fuse this to a shell.

name: Monster Hardbone
description:
A precious wyvern bone.
Difficult to forge, but
prized for its strength.

name: Elder Drgn Bone
description:
A bone from an elder dragon.
It exudes the great majesty
of the beast.

name: Mystery Bone
description:
A weathered bone. Not sturdy
enough to use for crafting.

name: Unknown Skull
description:
Animal skull. So worn and
weathered, its origin is
unidentifiable.

name: Master's Skull
description:
The remains of a top hunter
who once let his guard down.

name: Bone
description:
A long, thin bone. So worn
and weathered, its origin
is unidentifiable.

name: Jumbo Bone
description:
A large, thick bone. Often
cut apart in workshops for
use in crafting.

name: Wyvern Fang
description:
A fang used in Bowgun bullet
points. Gunpowder shatters
these, generating shrapnel.

name: Wyvern Claw
description:
A claw used in Bowgun bullet
points. Gunpowder triggers a
blast with a wide radius.

name: Wyvern Gem
description:
Throughout a wyvern's life,
impurities gather and form
this peculiar gem.

name: Wyvern Tear
description:
Bitter tears wept by wyverns
on certain occasions.
~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Territorial Dung
description:
Monsters leave these lumps
of dung to mark territory.
~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Crab Pearl
description:
A jewel formed inside the
body over many, many years.
~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Dragon Treasure
description:
A shiny rock that elder
dragons like to collect.
~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Decayed Scale
description:
A dragon scale that long
years have reduced to this
sad husk.

name: Dragon Stone
description:
A hard crystal made from
dragon scales. Valued as
medicine. ~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Mosswine Hide
description:
A musty hide covered in
moss.

name: Mosswine Head
description:
A Mosswine head. Usually
discarded, it is proof of
one's peculiar tastes.

name: Bullfango Pelt
description:
A pelt from a Bullfango,
covered in bristly fur.

name: Bullfango Head
description:
A Bullfango head, complete
with two splendid tusks.

name: Bulldrome Hide
description:
The hide of a Bulldrome.
Its bristliness has a 
certain beauty to it.

name: Bulldrome Hide+
description:
The tough, unblemished hide
of a Bulldrome.

name: Kelbi Horn
description:
An infusion of powdered
Kelbi Horn that works
wonders on stomachaches.

name: Kelbi Hide
description:
A hide used as protection
against the cold and as a
binding for armor.

name: Anteka Pelt
description:
A fluffy hide carved from
an Anteka. Boasts excellent
heat retention.

name: Anteka Antler
description:
An antler often used as raw
material for armor. Popular
with interior decorators.

name: Velociprey Fang
description:
A sharp, durable fang taken
from a Velociprey. Used to
make Bowgun ammo.

name: Velociprey Scale
description:
A scale obtained by carving
up a Velociprey. Blue and
black in color.

name: Velociprey Scale+
description:
A scale stripped from a
Velociprey. It can be made
into light, durable armor.

name: Velociprey Hide
description:
A hide stripped of its
scales. Used to join the
plates in a suit of armor.

name: Velocidrome Hide
description:
The hide of a Velociprey
leader. It bears the scars
of a leadership role.

name: Velocidrome Claw
description:
The claw of a Velocidrome.
Its tip is as deadly as a
sharpened knife.

name: Velocidrome Claw+
description:
A sharp Velocidrome claw.
It can easily slice through
prey.

name: Velocidrome Head
description:
A large head with a crest.
You'd look pretty fierce if
you put it on.

name: Giaprey Scale
description:
A Giaprey scale. The color
allows you to stalk prey in
the snow undetected.

name: Giaprey Hide
description:
A hide stripped of all its
scales. Used by villagers to
make clothing.

name: Genprey Fang
description:
A poisonous Genprey fang.
The paralyzing toxin works
even on wyverns.

name: Genprey Scale
description:
A Genprey scale. Acts as
camouflage in desert areas.

name: Genprey Scale+
description:
Scale taken from a Genprey.
Strong enough to repel a
wyvern's fangs.

name: Genprey Hide
description:
A hide with all the scales
removed. Can be tanned and
turned into leather.

name: Gendrome Hide
description:
Sturdy green Gendrome hide.
Perfect for making strong
armor.

name: Gendrome Head
description:
The head of a Gendrome.
Noted for its two crests.

name: Ioprey Fang
description:
A fang filled with deadly
poison. Handle with care!

name: Ioprey Scale
description:
Scale from an Ioprey. The
poison irritates the skin
so has been removed.

name: Ioprey Scale+
description:
A quality Ioprey scale. Can
be used in crafting once the
poison has been removed.

name: Ioprey Hide
description:
Descaled hide, often made
into belts. Red belts are
used in decorations.

name: Iodrome Hide
description:
A sturdy red hide from an
Iodrome. Perfect for making
strong armor.

name: Iodrome Head
description:
An Iodrome head with a
large, eye-catching crest.

name: Kut-Ku Scale
description:
Pink scale from a Kut-Ku.
Fire resistant. Can be found
in the field.

name: Kut-Ku Shell
description:
The Fire-resistant shell of
a Kut-Ku.

name: Kut-Ku Carapace
description:
Harder than Kut-Ku Shell,
this material is also known
as Gravite.

name: Kut-Ku Ear
description:
The Fire-resistant ear of
a Kut-Ku. Used to prevent
Bowguns backfiring.

name: Kut-Ku Auricle
description:
A Kut-Ku's Fire-resistant
ear. The flexible material
is a good base for armor.

name: Giant Beak
description:
The huge, sturdy beak of a
Yian Kut-Ku.

name: Splendid Beak
description:
Finding a large, beautiful
beak in this condition is
quite rare! Splendid!

name: Kut-Ku Webbing
description:
Webbing from a Kut-Ku wing.
Better than animal skin as
a fusing material.

name: B.Kut-Ku Scale
description:
A rare, blue Kut-Ku scale,
known for its unmatched hue.

name: B.Kut-Ku Shell
description:
A hard, blue Kut-Ku shell.
Its vibrant color makes it
quite popular.

name: B.Kut-Ku Carpace
description:
Harder than the shell,
this blue carapace is
in high demand.

name: Rubbery Hide
description:
Highly elastic Gypceros
hide. A good insulator,
resistant to electricity.

name: Rubbery Hide+
description:
High-quality, highly elastic
Gypceros hide. Gives off a
strange scent.

name: Gypceros Head
description:
The uniquely shaped head of
a Gypceros. A must have for
Gypceros lovers!

name: Rubbery Prp Hide
description:
A rarely seen rubbery Purple
Gypceros hide. This chic
purple hide is en vogue.

name: P.Gypceros Wing
description:
The seldom seen purple wing
of a Gypceros. Incredibly
valuable.

name: Piscine Liver
description:
An organ said to provide
relief from many ailments.
~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Piscine Fang
description:
Fang from a piscine, taken
from its many rows of sharp
teeth.

name: Plesioth Scale
description:
The dull, azure scale of a
Plesioth. Becomes brittle
out of water.

name: Plesioth Scale+
description:
A superior Plesioth scale.
Even dry, it shimmers in
light.

name: Plesioth Fin
description:
A beautiful Plesioth fin.
Its spines can easily knock
anyone out.

name: G.Plesioth Scale
description:
A glossy, Green Plesioth 
scale that shimmers like
a jewel.

name: G.Plesioth Fin
description:
A superior fin from a Green
Plesioth. A perfect fit for
any decoration.

name: Cephalos Scale
description:
A sand wyvern scale. Its
color is a brilliant blue.
Retains moisture.

name: Cephalos Scale+
description:
High-quality sand wyvern
scale. It absorbs moisture,
leaving it glowing blue.

name: Cephalos Fin
description:
A sand wyvern fin. It isn't
poisonous, but it's very
sharp.

name: Cephalos Fin+
description:
A quality fin, sharper than
other comparable samples.

name: Coral Cphlos Scl
description:
A coral sand wyvern scale.
The vivid purple is popular
with hunters.

name: Coral Cphlos Fin
description:
A coral sand wyvern fin.
The faint pink color is
quite cute.

name: Rathian Scale
description:
A scale from a Rathian. Its
focus is her nest. Its mate
is a male Rathalos.

name: Rathian Scale+
description:
A superior Rathian scale.
Looks like a normal scale,
but is extremely hard.

name: Rathian Plate
description:
A searing tail scale. Hard
to come by and as fiery as
the wyvern it came from.

name: Rathian Ruby
description:
A rare, precious gem from
inside a wyvern. Almost too
nice to use.

name: Rathian Shell
description:
A shell piece comprised of
layered scales, making it
much harder than just one.

name: Rathian Carapace
description:
A sturdy Rathian carapace.
Even harder than a normal
Rathian Shell.

name: Rathian Spike
description:
Needle-like hair found on
a Rathian's back and wings.
They contain poison.

name: Rathian Spike+
description:
As sharp as the keenest
blade. Longer and sturdier
than other spikes.

name: P.Rathian Scale
description:
A scale from the elusive
Pink Rathian. Colored like
cherry-blossom petals.

name: P.Rathian Scale+
description:
A superior scale from a Pink
Rathian. Incredibly tough,
yet fashionable.

name: P.Rathian Shell
description:
A shell formed from Pink
Rathian scales tempered by
the passage of time.

name: P.Rathian Cpc
description:
A superior Pink Rathian
shell. Vivid and beautiful,
used for various equipment.

name: G.Rathian Scale+
description:
Scale carved from a Gold
Rathian. Brilliant, even
at night.

name: G.Rathian Cpc
description:
A hard shell covered in
shining gold scales. As
gorgeous as a gold bar.

name: Rath Wingtalon
description:
A talon cut from the wing
of a flying wyvern, often
broken in combat.

name: Rath Marrow
description:
Recent advances allow this
marrow to be extracted. It
ignites on air contact.

name: Rathalos Scale
description:
Wyvern scales like this one
and the harder shells are
basic forging items.

name: Rathalos Scale+
description:
An extraordinarily durable
Rathalos scale.

name: Rathalos Plate
description:
A searing tail scale. Hard
to come by and as fiery as
the wyvern it came from.

name: Rathalos Ruby
description:
A rare, precious gem from
inside a wyvern. Almost too
nice to use.

name: Rathalos Shell
description:
A shell piece comprised of
layered scales, making it
much harder than just one.

name: Rathalos Carpace
description:
A rigid Rathalos carapace.
Even harder than a normal
Rathalos Shell.

name: Rathalos Tail
description:
A severed Rathalos tail.
It has any number of uses.

name: Rathalos Webbing
description:
This heat-resistant material
is often used to line armor.

name: Rathalos Wing
description:
Wing removed from the body.
Skilled artisans can craft
it into strong equipment.

name: A.Rathalos Scale
description:
A scale from the elusive
Azure Rathalos. It shines
like the night sky.

name: A.Rath Scale+
description:
A high-grade Azure Rathalos
scale. Both its beauty and
strength are shocking.

name: A.Rathalos Shell
description:
An Azure Rathalos shell.
Made up of numerous hardened
scales clustered together.

name: A.Rathalos Cpc
description:
A vivid Azure Rathalos
carapace. Used to make
various equipment.

name: A.Rathalos Tail
description:
Severed tail of an Azure
Rathalos. Sells at a high
price due to its rarity.

name: A.Rathalos Wing
description:
Wing removed from the body.
Excellent for forging both
weapons and armor.

name: S.Rathalos Scl+
description:
Quality scale carved from a
Silver Rathalos. It has a
moon-like shine.

name: S.Rathalos Cpc
description:
Carapace carved from a
Silver Rathalos. The silver
scales have an icy shine.

name: S.Rathalos Tail
description:
Severed tail of a Silver
Rathalos. Sells at a high
price due to its rarity.

name: S.Rath Webbing
description:
Difficult to forge with, but
prized for its enhancing
properties.

name: S.Rathalos Wing
description:
A silver wing that has been
removed. Its enchanting glow
is admired by many a hunter.

name: Flabby Hide
description:
Finally usable as a material
thanks to recent advances.
Has mysterious properties.

name: Pearl Hide
description:
The hide of a Khezu. Its
strange properties are still
not fully understood.

name: Pale Bone
description:
The rib bone from a Khezu.
Still has chunks of meat
attached.

name: Pale Steak
description:
Fatty meat from a Khezu.
Looks tasty, but cannot
be eaten.

name: Alluring Hide
description:
Hide with a bewitching
glaze. Just looking at it
makes you feel strange.

name: Alluring Webbing
description:
Hard to craft but extremely
useful. Treasured for its
multi-colored hues.

name: Basarios Shell
description:
A Basarios shell with a
rock-like consistency.
Can be forged into metal.

name: Basarios Carpace
description:
Harder than Basarios shell,
this material is also known
as Gravite.

name: Basarios Wing
description:
The wing of a Basarios.
Very hard to work as a
material.

name: Gravios Marrow
description:
A precious material that
requires talent to properly
harvest.

name: Gravios Shell
description:
The stone-like shell of a
Gravios. May contain traces
of ore.

name: Gravios Carapace
description:
Even harder than a normal
Gravios Shell.

name: Gravios Scalp
description:
A part carved from the head
of a Gravios. Incredibly
hard to work with.

name: B.Gravios Shell
description:
A shell of the elusive Black
Gravios. Its deep black hue
exudes power.

name: B.Gravios Cpc
description:
A charred Black Gravios
carapace. Difficult to
forge with.

name: B.Gravios Scalp
description:
A part carved from the head
of a Black Gravios. Looks
like a terrifying dark mask.

name: Twisted Horn
description:
A twisted Diablos horn.
Used in this region for many
(less twisted) purposes.

name: Majestic Horn
description:
A twisted Diablos horn in
great shape. Use it to make
more powerful weapons.

name: Diablos Shell
description:
This shell piece is dense,
as one knock will tell you,
and heavier than it looks.

name: Diablos Carapace
description:
Even harder than a normal
Diablos Shell.

name: Diablos Ridge
description:
A rock-hard backplate piece
that can be used to make
equipment if cut properly.

name: Diablos Ridge+
description:
The hardest part of a
Diablos's backplate. Very
difficult to carve off.

name: Diablos Tail
description:
An armored tailcase that
puts iron hammers to shame.
This material is a keeper.

name: Blos Fang
description:
A large, sturdy fang from
a Diablos or Monoblos.
Stays sharp.

name: Black Spiralhorn
description:
The twisted horn of a Black
Diablos. Its blunt, lustrous
form is truly majestic.

name: B.Diablos Shell
description:
A Black Diablos shell. Its
pitch dark hue is beloved
by countless hunters.

name: B.Diablos Ridge
description:
A Black Diablos backplate.
Its finely carved armor is
immensely heavy.

name: B.Diablos Tail
description:
A massive Black Diablos
tailcase. Reminiscent of
a large iron hammer.

name: B.Diablos Cpc
description:
A carapace that is even
more resistant than that of
a normal Diablos.

name: Vespoid Abdomen
description:
The abdomen of a Vespoid
queen. Occasionally found
filled with eggs.

name: Vespoid Shell
description:
With special materials,
it can be worked into
very strong armor.

name: Vespoid Carapace
description:
A hard Vespoid carapace.
Exhibits special properties
when processed.

name: Vespoid Wing
description:
Difficult to forge with --
the results vary depending
on which surface you use.

name: Vespoid InnrWng
description:
Blade-shaped innerwing of a
Vespoid. The secret behind
the beast's killing prowess.

name: Hornetaur Shell
description:
With special materials,
it can be worked into
very strong armor.

name: Hornetaur Head
description:
A sharp horned shell. With
special materials, it can be
used for weapons or armor.

name: Hornetaur Wing
description:
A hard-to-work material.
Appears pearl-like when
struck by light.

name: HornetaurInnrWng
description:
A blade-shaped innerwing of
a Hornetaur. The secret to
its killing prowess.

name: Small Lobstershl
description:
The shell from a King
Lobster. A rare find.

name: Large Lobstershl
description:
A large shell from a King
Lobster that was used as
bait. Very rare.

name: Giant Lobstershl
description:
A large shell from a King
Lobster that was used as
bait. Luxurious.

name: Amezari Shell
description:
A rare large shell from the
America Zarigani. One of a
kind.

name: Scarlet Horn
description:
The pride of the Monoblos.
Obtaining it grants you the
title of "Hero of Kokoto".

name: Monoblos Shell
description:
The shell of the Monoblos,
a Diablos subspecies whose
whole body has darkened.

name: Monoblos Ridge
description:
A tough Monoblos shell.
Used to craft various
equipment.

name: Monoblos Heart
description:
The heart of a Monoblos.
Symbolizes unadulterated
anger.

name: Argent Horn
description:
A White Monoblos horn.
Its beautiful silver gleam
is coveted by all.

name: W.Monoblos Shell
description:
A White Monoblos shell.
Coveted for its pristine
white hue.

name: W.Monoblos Ridge
description:
A White Monoblos backplate.
Its finely carved armor
gleams in pure silver.

name: Kirin Thndrhorn
description:
The horn of Kirin, as
powerful as a lightning
bolt. Exquisite material.

name: Kirin Hide
description:
A rare and lovely hide, but
difficult to carve loose and
dangerous to handle.

name: Kirin Hide+
description:
A rare and lovely hide. This
one is undamaged: proof of
its former owner's strength.

name: Kirin Mane
description:
A rare, dashing mane that
retains its dignity even
after being cut free.

name: Kirin Thndrtail
description:
A rare tail, overflowing
with elegance, charged with
electricity.

name: Kirin Azure Horn
description:
An azure horn, rare even
among Kirin Horns. Gives
off a divine light.

name: Lao-Shan Claw
description:
Massive claw of Lao-Shan
Lung. Impossible to work,
so it must be used as-is.

name: Lao-Shan Horn
description:
Horn from Lao-Shan Lung
snout. It's compatible with
Firestone. A prized find.

name: Lao-Shan Scale
description:
An easy to craft red scale
whose hardness is on par
with any wyvern cortex.

name: Lao-Shan Ruby
description:
A rare gem formed inside a
Lao-Shan Lung. Its fiery red
embodies the dragon's soul.

name: Lao-Shan Shell
description:
Shell of Lao-Shan Lung.
The thickness of this shell
tells you of its age.

name: Lao-Shan Carpace
description:
A Lao-Shan Lung carapace.
The passage of time has made
it even sturdier.

name: Azure Lao Horn
description:
A giant, mountain-like
horn. Worthy of a place
in a treasure vault.

name: Azure Lao Shell
description:
A giant mountain-like shell.
Its size is now close to
that of bedrock.

name: Fatalis Horn
description:
One of the four horns from
the dragon's head. Said to
contain the beast's power.

name: Fatalis Scale
description:
A scale from Fatalis's body
that goes on to form its
shell.

name: Fatalis Shell
description:
A multi-layered carapace
that cannot be damaged by
normal weaponry.

name: Fatalis Eye
description:
The crystalline eyeball of
Fatalis. One of the Three
Great Treasures.

name: Fatalis Webbing
description:
The large surface area makes
this material very useful.
Best used while fresh.

name: Fatalis Bloodhrn
description:
A Fatalis horn dyed crimson
with hate. Glows red, even
after it has been cut off.

name: Fatalis Bloodscl
description:
A Fatalis scale dyed crimson
with hate. Emits a crimson
light in the darkness.

name: Fatalis Bloodshl
description:
A shell dyed crimson with
hate. Its sheen seems to
contain residual thoughts.

name: Fatalis Devileye
description:
The eye of an angered
Fatalis. Its fiendish gaze
is too much for some.

name: Fatalis Bloodwng
description:
A jet black wing swirling
with crimson, which looks
like lava in the night.

name: Old Fatalis Scl
description:
A noble, yet fierce scale
that shines even in the
impenetrable darkness.

name: Old Fatalis Shl
description:
A rare shell carved from
a giant dragon. Time has
hardened it beyond measure.

name: Old Fatalis Wbng
description:
A wing with a disastrous,
divine aura. Shines with
an ominous glow.

name: Old Fatalis Horn
description:
A horn with a power that is
incomparable to that of any
ordinary dragon horn.

name: Belkuros
description:
Monster List reference info
on the habits and ecology of
Belkuros.

name: Pariapuria
description:
Monster List reference info
on the habits and ecology of
Pariapuria.

name: Sharp Claw
description:
A shining black claw. Unlike
wyvern claws, this is shaped
to grip objects.

name: Blangonga Fang
description:
The fang of the killer
Blangonga. As sharp and
deadly as a dagger.

name: Blangonga Fang+
description:
A Blangonga dogtooth. As
large as a human thigh, it
has potential as a weapon.

name: Blangonga Pelt
description:
An outstanding insulator,
whose every hair is as
strong as an iron chain.

name: Blangonga Pelt+
description:
A tough Blango pelt. Its
durable hairs are prized
as a processing material.

name: Blango Whisker
description:
A fine hair that sprouted
from the face of a Blangonga
troop leader.

name: Blangonga Tail
description:
The smooth feeling of a
Blangonga Tail is undeniably
appealing.

name: Congalala Pelt
description:
The pink fur of a Congalala.
The tufts of hair are often
used in clothing.

name: Vibrant Pelt
description:
Vibrant hair that grows on
the head of a Congalala.
The colors are lovely.

name: Congalala Claw
description:
A Congalala Claw.
Large and sharp, it has a
black luster.

name: Congalala Fang
description:
The fang of a Congalala.
Solid enough to crunch
objects into dust.

name: Congalala Pelt+
description:
The stout fur of Congalala.
Important crafting material.

name: Congalala Claw+
description:
A long, hard, sharp claw
with a wild nature that
makes crafting difficult.

name: Rajang Horn
description:
The majestic golden horn of
a Rajang. Hunters yearn for
the heroism it represents.

name: Rajang Fang
description:
This sharpened fang can cut
through anything dumb enough
to touch it.

name: Rajang Blackfur
description:
When crafted, the resulting
fabric is desired even by
royalty.

name: Rajang Claw
description:
A sharp Rajang claw.
Difficult to carve and
more difficult to craft.

name: Rajang Tail
description:
The glistening tail of a
Rajang. The golden fur is
beautiful and elegant.

name: Gold Rajang Pelt
description:
Fur taken from a Rajang's
body. The golden hair is
treasured by tailors.

name: Carapaceon Brains
description:
A rare delicacy, if you like
the other type of noodle...
~C05(Account Item)

name: Wyvern Scalp
description:
A Carapaceon shell made from
a wyvern's skull.

name: Sm Hermitaur Shl
description:
A large piece of exoskeleton
that's surprisingly light
and easy to use in crafting.

name: Hermitaur Shell
description:
A piece of bone from a giant
Carapaceon. Its small form
means it has limited use.

name: Hermitaur Claw
description:
A giant claw from a Daimyo
Hermitaur. The sharp claw
can slice through rock.

name: Hermitaur Cpc
description:
The hard carapace of a
Daimyo Hermitaur. Harder
than shell to work.

name: Hermitaur Claw+
description:
Sharp claw from a Daimyo
Hermitaur. As hard as metal.

description:
A piece of a giant Ceanataur
Shell. Lighter than it looks
and easy to craft.

name: Ceanataur Shell
description:
A giant Shogun Ceanataur
Shell. Has a distinctive
color and shape.

name: Ceanataur Cpc
description:
Harder than a Ceanataur
Shell, this carapace is
harder to work with.

name: Ceanataur Leg
description:
A Shogun Ceanataur leg.
Incredibly strong to support
the beast's massive body.

name: Ceanataur Pincer
description:
Seeing a Shogun's pincer
blade causes even the
bravest hunters to flinch.

name: Ceanataur Claw
description:
A giant Shogun Ceanataur
claw. Those who fall in
its path pay a dear price.

name: Ceanataur Claw+
description:
The sharp claw of a giant
Shogun Ceanataur. It's a
true menace to hunters.

Carved from Shen Gaoren.
Shaped by time, this shell
is harder than even metal.

name: Gaoren Ridge
description:
Shell from the spine of
Gaoren. Guards the body
with incredible tenacity.

name: Gaoren Pincer
description:
Giant pincer from a Shen
Gaoren. It can slice even
metal; deadly to hunters.

name: Gaoren Claw
（ダミー）
description: ダミー。

name: Daora Shell
description:
The shining silver Kushala
Daora shell is solid and
highly useful.

name: Daora Carapace
description:
A shell hardened by time.
Crafting it is incredibly
difficult.

name: Daora Scale
description:
A scale that glows a dull
silver. Hard enough to serve
as an abrasive for weapons.

name: Daora Webbing
description:
Hard to craft but highly
compatible with metals.
Valued for its light weight.

name: Daora Horn
description:
The gallant horn of Daora.
Using it requires extra-
ordinary experience.

name: Daora Tail
description:
Cut from Kushala Daora.
Incredibly destructive
power contained within.

name: Daora Claw
description:
Kushala Daora's claw. As
hard as ore, it cannot be
used by ordinary crafters.

name: Daora Claw+
description:
Even now the black gleam of
this claw seems to emit a
life force.

name: Daora Gem
description:
A rare gem formed inside a
Kushala Daora. Its glow is
breathtaking.

name: Decayed Shell
description:
A rusted Daora shell. The
right craftsman might be
able to salvage it.

name: Decayed Webbing
description:
The decayed wing of a
Kushala Daora. Might be of
use if the rust is removed.

name: Decayed Webbing+
description:
A rusted Daora wing. Though
decayed, it has retained its
properties.

name: Chameleos Hide
description:
This hide is so strange to
the touch, you'll want to
rub it all over your face.

name: Chameleos Hide+
description:
Superior hide of Chameleos.
Strange to the touch, but
very durable.

name: Chameleos Horn
description:
Faintly glows with a white
light. Great for interior
decorating.

name: Chameleos Spike
description:
A sharp horn of a Chameleos.
Strong and hard, but
strangely easy to work with.

name: Chameleos Claw
description:
Thin, yet incredibly strong
and very easy to work with
during crafting.

name: Chameleos Wbng
description:
Thin, light wing webbing.
The inner part is highly
durable.

name: Chameleos Tail
description:
The distinctive tail of
Chameleos. Feels very
strange.

name: Chameleos Gem
description:
A rare gem formed inside
Chameleos. It has a multi-
colored glow.

A scalding hot scale. It'll
take your fingerprints right
off.

name: Fire Dragon Claw
description:
A sharp, glowing Fire Dragon
claw. Hard even for experts
to craft.

description:
Powder from fire dragon
wings. Said to magnify a
material's abilities.

name: Teostra Gem
description:
A rare gem formed inside a
fire dragon. Flickers with
ferocious flames.

name: Elder Drgn Blood
description:
Contains an unknown
ingredient, the object of
much scholarly research.

name: Fire Dragon Scl+
description:
A scale from a majestic fire
dragon. It burns with hot
fire from within.

description:
The shell of a Lunastra.
Its graceful blue hue is
second to none.

name: Lunastra Mane
description:
A dignified Lunastra mane.
The silky hairs make this a
classy material.

name: Lunastra Webbing
description:
A quality Lunastra webbing.
Treasured for its unmatched
blue hue.

name: Lunastra Tail
description:
The tail of a Lunastra.
Capable of crushing rocks
in one fell swoop.

name: Lunastra Horn
description:
An elegant Lunastra horn.
Its presence enthrals all
who gaze upon it.

A red hot Teostra shell.
It proves its domain over
all fire.

name: Teostra Carapace
Teostra Mane
description:
This majestic mane is a sure
sign of Teostra's regality.

name: Teostra Webbing
description:
Wing webbing carved from a
fire dragon. A marvelous
material with many uses.

name: Teostra Tail
description:
Covered in red scales, the
tree like tail of Teostra is
incredibly hard to cut.

name: Teostra Horn
description:
A horn that displays the
power of Teostra. Hunters
wither before its might.

name: Teostra Horn+
description:
A sharp horn that burns with
the fury of Teostra. It is
tinged with fire.

name: Tsukami Fin
description:
A fillet from Yama Tsukami
tentacle. Slimy and light.

name: Tsukami Hide
description:
Hide carved from a Yama 
Tsukami. Can be made into
textile with processing.

name: Tsukami Fluid
description:
Fluid extracted from a Yama
Tsukami. Black and sticky.

name: Dragonmoss
description:
Moss found on Yama Tsukami.
The giant's body has given
it mysterious powers.

name: Dragonwood
description:
A tree that grows on Yama
Tsukami. It's surrounded by
a truly mysterious air.

A glossy and subdued black
hide taken from a Remobra.

A lustrous and elegant black
hide taken from a Remobra.

name: Striped Skin
description:
Unassuming black-and-red
hues from a Remobra that
some hunters swear by.

name: Remobra Head
description:
The snake-like head of a
Remobra. It still looks
ready to pounce!

name: Garuga Scale
description:
A scale carved from a Yian
Garuga. It shines an ominous
purple.

name: Garuga Shell
description:
A rare item, also in great
demand as a research
material.

name: Garuga Ear
description:
Its shape and form show a
different evolutionary path
than Yian Kut-Ku.

name: Sharpened Beak
description:
The sharpened beak of a Yian
Garuga. Looks fiercer than
that of a Kut-Ku.

name: Garuga Wing
description:
A first class material that
requires considerable skill
to work with.

name: Garuga Tail
description:
The tail of a Yian Garuga.
Responds to shocks by
spouting a powerful venom.

name: Garuga Mane
description:
Mane from a Yian Garuga.
Unusually intimidating.

name: Lost Umbrella
description:
A noblewoman's umbrella.
It seems to have some hidden
features. Try fixing it.

name: Chief's Sword+
description:
A copy of one of the swords

elder. A symbol of heroism.

name: Stone Fist

A stone in the shape of a

name: Broken Dragonator

A broken Dragonator.
Despite its condition, it

name: Strongarm Chain+
description:
Modeled on a chain used by
a certain captain. Proof of

name: Plesioth Fin+

A radiant fin. Below the
surface lie sharp barbs
with a deadly neurotoxin.

name: G.Plesioth Scl+
description:
A quality Green Plesioth
scale. Its hue enthralls
all who see it.

name: G.Plesioth Fin+
description:
Quality Green Plesioth fin.
Flexible, easy to process,
and widely used in jewelry.

name: Rath Fluid
description:
Heat-producing fluid from a
Rathian or Rathalos. Used to
craft equipment.

name: Rath Medulla
description:
Recent advances allow this
marrow to be extracted. It
ignites on air contact.

name: Basarios Tears
description:
Faintly pink gems found
near the tear ducts of a
Basarios.

name: Gravios Medulla
description:
This brain stem is a
precious but hard to
craft Gravios part.

name: B.Diablos Ridge+
description:
A hard Black Diablos back-
plate. Even hot desert winds
can't erode such sturdiness.

name: Hornetaur Cpc
description:
The hard part of a Hornetaur
shell. Exhibits special
properties when worked.

name: Lao-Shan Scale+
description:
A dark red Lao-Shan scale.
Its toughness rivals that
of a flying wyvern shell.

name: Gaoren Carapace
description:
Carved from Shen Gaoren.
Shaped by time, this shell
is harder than even metal.

name: Gaoren Thoracic
description:
A hard Shen Gaoren shell.
Its strength makes the beast
a walking fortress.

name: Fire Dragon Wbng
description:
Wing webbing carved from a
fire dragon. A marvelous
material with many uses.

name: Dragonmoss+
description:
The miraculous power of
this material can raise the
quality of crafted goods.

name: Dragonwood+
description:
Shining Dragonwood. Its
beauty can be transferred
to equipment.

name: Tigrex Scale
description:
Scale from the incredibly
violent Tigrex. Incredibly
massive and sturdy.

name: Tigrex Scale+
description:
A flawless Tigrex scale.
Can be fastened with others
to become harder than steel.

name: Tigrex Shell
description:
A hard Tigrex shell capable
of repelling any impact.
Extreme tenacity.

name: Tigrex Carapace
description:
A material hardened by the
sands of time. Sharp edges
show the Tigrex's ferocity.

name: Tigrex Tail
description:
This flexible and strong
tail can be used to forge
great equipment.

name: Tigrex Claw
description:
A vicious foreclaw unique
to the Tigrex. Other flying
wyverns do not have it.

name: Tigrex Claw+
description:
A claw that time has
sharpened into a horrible
death sentence for prey.

name: Tigrex Fang
description:
A terrifying fang used to
crush prey. Makes all who
see it quiver in fear.

name: Tigrex Fang+
description:
The sharp fang of a Tigrex.
These fangs can cut any prey
to shreds.

name: Tigrex Scalp
description:
A part of the Tigrex's head.
Looks terrifying, as if it
is still alive.

name: Akantor Scale+
description:
A splendid scale with a
faint glow. Requires cooling
after all that time in lava.

name: Akantor Carapace
description:
Shining Akantor Shell.
Exceptionally hard, and thus
difficult to craft.

name: Akantor Tail
description:
The large rock-like tail of
an Akantor. Strong enough to
gouge the earth.

name: Akantor Hardclaw
description:
Hard Akantor claw that can
smash bedrock. Its victims
are left unrecognizable.

name: Akantor Tallfang
description:
Huge fang that can pierce
the heavens. It has passed
through many foes.

name: Akantor Spike
description:
A flawless spike from an
Akantor. It can easily scar
rock.

name: Hypno Pelt
description:
The pelt of a Hypnocatrice.
Strong, supple, and vivid
orange in hue.

name: Hypno Claw
description:
A hard to break claw with a 
dull black luster. Used to
decorate equipment.

name: Rainbow Quill
description:
An iridescent tail feather.
Widely used as a decoration
and beloved by young nobles.

name: Hypno Beak
description:
An intricately shaped beak. 
Its unique form is beloved
by certain hunters.

name: Hypno Bezoar
description:
A stone swallowed to aid
digestion, now turned into
a clear, radiant crystal.

name: Hypno Pelt+
description:
An outstandingly beautiful
Hypnocatrice pelt. Used as
a crafting material.

name: Hypno Beak+
description:
A well-shaped beak that
boasts fang-like sharpness
and exceptional toughness.

name: Hypno Claw+
description:
A quality claw carved from
a Hypnocatrice. Razor sharp,
hard, and lustrous.

name: Hypno Bezoar+
description:
A pure, beautifully shaped
bezoar. A treasure coveted
by noble ladies.

name: Blue Hypno Pelt
description:
Vibrant blue feathers grown
to attract a mate. Found on
Vivid Hypnocatrice.

name: Blue Hypno Pelt+
description:
A top-quality pelt carved
from a Vivid Hypnocatrice.
Perfect for crafting gear.

name: Lavasioth Scale
description:
A golden Lavasioth scale.
Capable of withstanding
boiling hot lava.

name: Lavasioth Shell
description:
A carapace encrusted with
hardened minerals, making
for excellent armor.

name: Lavasioth Fang
description:
The fang of a Lavasioth.
Strong enough to crush
crustaceans with ease.

name: Lavasioth Fin
description:
A fin with a naturally
razor sharp edge. Prized
as a weapon material.

name: Lavasioth Scale+
description:
A superior Lavasioth scale.
The encrusted lava leaves
behind a gold sheen.

name: Lavasioth Cpc
description:
A shell encrusted with rare,
hardened ore. Even wyverns
struggle to scratch it.

name: Lavasioth Fang+
description:
A sharp Lavasioth fang.
Its size is unusual for a 
piscine wyvern.

name: Lavasioth Fin+
description:
A quality fin sharpened into
a virtual weapon due to the
lava's heat.

name: Accord Ticket
description:
A ticket given to hunters
bound by an unbreakable
friendship.

name: Bronze N Medal
description:
A bronze medal made of rare
ore. Inscribed with a "N"-
shaped mark.

name: Silver N Medal
description:
A silver medal made of rare
ore. Inscribed with a "N"-
shaped mark.

name: Gold N Medal
description:
A gold medal made of rare
ore. Inscribed with a "N"-
shaped mark.

name: Neodymium Note
description:
A fragment of a long lost
crafting tome, known only
by the name "Neodymium".

name: Mercury Note
description:
A fragment of a long lost
crafting tome, known only
by the name "Mercury".

name: Clan Ticket
description:
A ticket used as currency
in the Clan Hall. Mainly
obtained from Clan Quests.

name: BlackMarketCoin
description:
A coin sold sold at a fixed
price on the black market.
Also known as "The Goods".

name: RuggedWhtFabric
description:
肌触りも良く、吸収性も高い
白い布地。ジャンルを問わず、
いろいろな服に利用が可能。

name: Costume Parts
description:
服と相性の良いアクセサリー
を作るのに必要な素材。軽く
てキレイな仕上がりになる。

name: Striped Fabric
description:
規則正しい縞模様に織られた
布地。他の布地と合わせるこ
とで、色が替えられる。

name: Green Fabric
description:
深い緑をした布地。祭に参加
した者でないと作ってもらえ
ない、こだわりの限定品。

name: Fluffing Liquid
description:
特殊な技法により、布地をフワ
フワのモフモフにする。
爆発で行っているとの噂が。

name: Black Fabric
description:
ツルツルとした肌触りで、質
の高さもうなずける黒い布地。
主に特別な服に使用される。

name: Blue Fabric
description:
明るめの青い布地。伸縮性に
優れ、サイズに多少無理が
あっても、着れる服が作れる。

name: Pink Fabric
description:
優しい桃色をした布地。簡単
な必要素材ではないが、幅広い
年齢層から支持のある布地。

name: Clan Ticket X
description:
Awarded for completing an
Extra Quest. Master Tool
might have a use for it...

name: R.Lavasioth Shl
description:
The shell that covers a Red
Lavasioth's body. Contains
a heat-emitting mineral.

name: R.Lavasioth Fang
description:
A fang capable of enduring
scorching magma and crushing
just about anything.

name: R.Lavasioth Fin
description:
A fin from a Red Lavasioth.
Its sharpness makes it a
popular weapon material.

name: R.Lavasioth Cpc
description:
Contains a rare mineral
that emits a searing heat,
burning anyone nearby.

name: R.Lavasio Fang+
description:
A Red Lavasioth fang. Sharp
and strong, not even wyvern
shells can withstand it.

name: R.Lavasioth Fin+
description:
A top-class weapon material.
Very sharp, so great care
must be taken when crafting.

name: Pink Ticket
description:
A ticket depicting a Vivid
Hypnocatrice. Use it to add
color to various creations.

name: Christmas Card
description:
A mysterious card received
from a time-limited Quest.
Merry Christmas!

name: N.Year Gift (Rat)
description:
A bag received on New Year's
Eve. Filled with something,
but definitely not zenny.

name: Espinas Scale
description:
The scale of an Espinas.
Despite its countless scars,
its toughness is unmatched.

name: Espinas Carapace
description:
An exceptionally tough
Espinas shell. Breaking
it is no easy task.

name: Espinas Spike
description:
A toxic spike that serves
as both armor and weapon
for the Espinas.

name: Espinas Scalp
description:
A fragment of the Espinas's
head. Its presence remains
overwhelming, even in death.

name: Espinas Tail
description:
The tail of an Espinas. Its
countless spikes still carry
a deadly poison.

name: Espinas Ruby
description:
A gem that glows a vivid 
crimson, as if reflecting
its previous owner's rage.

name: Espinas Horn
description:
The pride of the Espinas.
A hard to craft horn steeped
in a miasma of death.

name: F.Espinas Scale+
description:
A scale made up of hardened
layers, reminiscent of a
tree's growth rings.

name: F.Espinas Cpc
description:
A tough shell with a deep
hue. Its color evokes the
image of an ancient tree.

name: F.Espinas Spike+
description:
A Flaming Espinas spike.
Its color and rough texture
make it stand out.

name: F.Espinas Scalp
description:
A Flaming Espinas scalp.
As threatening in death
as it was in life.

name: F.Espinas Tail
description:
A Flaming Espinas tail. The
venom within could knock out
a thousand Velociprey.

name: F.Espinas Ruby
description:
A blood red Flaming Espinas
ruby. Occasionally compared
to heartwood.

name: F.Espinas Horn+
description:
A Flaming Espinas horn. The
biggest and most venomous of
all its thorns.

name: F.Espinas Acid
description:
A dense, corrosive acid from
the Flaming Espinas. Used to
process equipment.

name: Vashim Carapace
description:
A shell made of the same
crystal as the Aqra Vashim.
Shows signs of past repair.

name: Vashim Claw+
description:
A sharp claw to rival that
of a Ceanataur. Emits an
ominous glow.

name: Vashim Jaw
description:
A large jaw capable of
crunching ore, yet used
solely for eating.

name: Vashim Crystal
description:
A volatile, crystallized
fluid secreted from the
Aqra Vashim's tail glands.

name: Vashim Tail+
description:
A flexible Aqra Vashim tail.
Used to strike targets with
relentless blows.

name: Wht Vashim Fluid
description:
The lifeblood of an Aqra
Vashim. Its color does not
change upon extraction.

description:

name: Wht Hypno Pelt+
description:
A top-quality pelt from a
rare Hypnocatrice, tinged
with a beautiful blue hue.

name: Silver Quill
description:
A silvery tail feather.
Prized as a decoration and
beloved by noblewomen.

name: White Hypno Beak
description:
A platinum beak with an icy,
keen edge. Used to exhale a
potent sleep-inducing gas.

name: Bug Repeller Tkt

Poogie Bug Repellent. Bring

name: Strega Edge Tkt

name: Old Material
description:
古びた石の塊に見えるが、
普通の石とは違う硬さと重さ
を備える。

name: Memorial Ticket
description:
A ticket given to hunters
who've ventured into the
unknown for the first time.

name: Crystal Shard
description:
A piece of crystal from the
Aqra Vashim.

name: Carapaceolite
description:
An ore made by Carapaceons.

description:
An ore made by Carapaceons.

description:
An ore made by Carapaceons.

description:
An amulet-shaped pouch.
There seems to be something
glowing inside.

name: Filial Memory
description:
An amulet-shaped pouch.
There seems to be something
warm inside.

name: Familial Bond
description:
An amulet-shaped pouch.
Its contents feel absolutely
priceless.

name: First Heart
description:
ある熟練ハンターの、家族や
仲間に対する思慕の念。命を
賭してでも守り抜く心意気。

name: Unrequited Soul
description:
その腕ひとつで荒波のような
現世を渡り歩く、ある男の意
地。己の進む道を切り拓く。

name: Bancho Ticket
description:
仁義を貫き通し、己の道をひ
たすらに突き進む信念を持つ
者の証。燃えるように熱い。

name: Black N Medal
description:
A black medal made of rare
ore. Inscribed with a "N"-

name: White N Medal
description:
A white medal made of rare
ore. Inscribed with a "N"-
shaped mark.

name: Gray N Medal
description:
A gray medal made of rare

shaped mark.

name: Artisan's Will
description:
飽く事なく技を鍛え上げる匠
に宿る根性。一度こうと決め
たら、音をあげることはない。

name: Artisan's Soul
description:
使う人を考えたモノ作りの心。
びっくりするほど、細やかな
心遣いが、愛すら感じさせる。

name: Artisan's Pride
description:
研き抜かれた腕に絶対の自信
がある匠にのみ宿る意地。
どんな難題もこなしてみせる。

A Raviente ruby. Its sheer
size is a sight to behold.

name: Raviente Hide
description:
The hide of a Raviente.
Despite its thinness, it
is surprisingly tough.

name: Raviente Scale
description:
A Raviente scale that grows
stronger with use. Beloved
by hunters.

name: Raviente Wing
description:
Though shaped like a fin,
its sheer size makes it a
wing.

name: Raviente Marrow
description:
A hard-to-extract marrow
hidden beneath a layer of
extremely thick bones.

name: Raviente Horn
description:
The horn of a Raviente.
Its immense gravitas defies
description.

name: Raviente Fang
description:
A Raviente fang. Equal in
size to a horn and tougher
than most known ores.

name: Raviente Tail
description:
A Raviente tail. As heavy
as lead, but exceptionally
flexible.

name: Raviente Spike
description:
The spike of a Raviente.
A giant rugged mass that is
undeserving of its name.

name: Power Gem
description:
A large crystal imbued with
intense heat. The potential
it offers is limitless.

name: Power Gem+
description:
A flawless crystal imbued
with a power even greater
than that of a Power Gem.

name: Rare Power Gem
description:
A wondrous crystal known as
the "King of Power Gems".
Priceless.

name: Dandelion Leaf
description:
A bone-hard, yet easy to
process leaf. Prized for
its rarity.

name: Subherb
description:
A versatile plant commonly
used a substitute for rare
materials during processing.

name: Wht Speckshroom
description:
A mushroom named after the
small white spots found on
its surface.

name: Rattleberry
description:
A berry that, once dried,
makes a lovely, crisp sound
when shaken.

name: Rustleweed
description:
A plant named for the
rustling sound it makes
when swaying in the wind.

name: Blk Speckshroom
description:
A mushroom named after the
small black spots found on
its surface.

name: Gemerald
description:
A crystal clear, green
mineral. Extremely rare,
and therefore valuable.

name: Striped Quartz
description:
A mineral characterized by
its striped pattern. No one
could hope to replicate it.

name: Beast Fossil
description:
A fossilized horn fragment
from an ancient monster.
Extremely tough.

name: Pink Crystal
description:
A heatproof, shock-resistant
crystal. Pure specimens sell
for a hefty sum.

name: Shroomstone
description:
A mineral shaped entirely
by nature -- and somehow
unmistakably mushroom-like.

name: Boardstone
description:
A thin, flat mineral. Its
sides are sturdy, but the
top and bottom are not.

name: Wealthbug
description:
An insect sometimes treated
as a money charm due to its
golden shell.

name: Branchbug
description:
A slow-moving insect that
looks just like a tree
branch.

name: Velocibutterfly
description:
A butterfly named for the
Velociprey-like pattern on
its wings.

name: Red Buttonbug
description:
An insect named for its
round shape and glossy
red wings.

name: Green Butterfly
description:
A butterfly named after the
green eye-like pattern found
on its wings.

name: Leafworm
description:
An insect whose color and
back closely resemble a
leaf.

name: Shaka Loincloth
description:
A leaf worn by Shakalaka
around the waist. Wait,
does this mean...

name: Smooth Stone
description:
A stone processed to have a
spherical surface. Coarse,
but well-rounded.

name: Bent Lumber
description:
An artificially curved piece
of wood. Used when a sturdy
material is required.

name: Soiled Rag
description:
A well-used scrap of cloth
that scarcely retains its
original shape -- or color.

name: Broken Knife
description:
A sliver of metal at the end
of the handle is all that
distinguishes it as a knife.

name: Thin Board
description:
Made by thinly slicing a
tree vertically. Sturdy if
layered with one another.

name: Delicate Flower
description:
A precious flower that only
blooms one a year -- if it
blooms at all.

name: Thirstberry
description:
A berry that grows without
much water. Eating it makes
you really thirsty.

name: Nectarless Herb
description:
A plant that lures insects
with a sweet, nectar-like
aroma, and eats them.

name: Humble Herb
description:
Not very tasty or suitable
for crafting, but still
worth gathering if you can.

name: Demon Cactus
description:
A cactus with distinctively
vivid flowers that stay in
bloom for over a month.

name: Goldberry Flower
description:
Unlike the juicy fruit it
produces, this plant's
flowers are bright blue.

name: Adamond
description:
A crystal clear, tough
mineral. Extremely rare,
and therefore valuable.

name: Litemacha Ore
description:
Makes for a versatile
material when refined.
Made mainly of crystals.

name: Litecarba Ore
description:
Makes for a versatile
material when refined.
Made mainly of metal.

name: Roundstone
description:
The forces of nature have
smoothed its edges, making
it appear rounded.

name: Rhinestone
description:
The forces of nature have
smoothed its edges, making
it look diamond-shaped.

name: Pentastone
description:
The forces of nature have
smoothed its edges, making
it look star-shaped.

name: Stag Beetle
description:
An insect with impressive
pincers and horns. Be sure
to approach it from behind.

name: Nailhopper
description:
Long, thin, and covered in
a hard shell, this bug could
easily be used as a nail.

name: Luminescent Worm
description:
A worm that stores light
during the day and glows
faintly all over at night.

name: Insect Exuvia
description:
Part of a huge bug's shell.
Looks and feels more like
thick tree bark, though.

name: Rainbug
description:
An insect often seen on
rainy days. Named for this
very reason.

name: Branhopper
description:
An unassuming grasshopper
distinguished by its rice
bran-like scent.

name: Felvine Necklace
description:
A necklace that's far too
small for any human. Seems
popular among Melynxes...

name: Broken Pickaxe
description:
A pickaxe rendered unusable
due to lack of a handle.
Its head has not rusted.

name: Polished Stone
description:
A flat polished stone that's
as reflective as a mirror.

name: Old Ladle
description:
Though ornate, this ladle
appears really old, and
therefore unusable.

name: Slender Stick
description:
As thick as your forearm and
twice as long, this stick
was crafted in a workshop.

name: Thick Braid
description:
A braid woven from chunky
ropes. More for practical
use than decoration.

name: Tsukami Cert.
description:
A certificate given only to
those who've triumphed over
the mightiest of dragons.

name: E.Dragon Fang
description:
The fang of a powerful elder
dragon. Extremely sharp, it
has an ominous gleam.

name: E.Dragon Gem
description:
A gem formed inside powerful
elder dragons. Glows with a
faint, beautiful luster.

name: Yearly Sub Ticket
description:
長きに渡り狩猟生活を続ける
ハンターに贈られる感謝の証。
特別な品と引換可能。

name: ダミー
description: dummy

name: Imp Coating
description:
Applies impact damage to the
arrows of Evolving Weapons.
Capacity: 30

name: Duragaua Scale
description:
A Duragaua scale. Prized as
a material for its toughness
and heat retention.

name: Duragaua Shell
description:
A shell made up of clustered
scales. Its color depends on
the outside temperature.

name: Duragaua Claw
description:
A sharp claw that produces
a distinctively loud noise

name: Duragaua Horn
description:

description:
A spiked Duragaua tail. Its
toughness makes wounding it
nearly impossible.

name: Duragaua Spike
description:
A Duragaua dorsal spike. Its
sharpness makes it extremely
dangerous to handle.

description:

blue color when illuminated.

description:

name: Duragaua Tail+
description:
A fine Duragaua tail with
imposing spikes. Sometimes
sold as a luxury item.

name: Duragaua Spike+
description:
A Duragaua spike that has
fully retained its razor
sharp edge. A rare find.

name: Duragaua Cert.
description:
A certificate given only to
those who've triumphed over
the most arduous of hunts.

name: Strong Beak
description:
An enormous Kut-Ku beak.
Even carrying it alone is
a real challenge!

name: Ferocious Beak
description:
A legendary Yian Kut-Ku
beak. One can almost hear
its fierce cry resound.

name: Divine Beak
description:
A top-quality beak from a
rare Yian Kut-Ku. Also known
as the "Beak of Fortune".

name: Congalala Talon
description:
A razor sharp Congalala
claw. Said to break rocks
with a single blow.

name: Congalala Gouger
description:
A curved, razor sharp claw.
Named for the way it rips
and gouges its prey.

name: Congalala Ripper
description:
A Congalala claw honed over
time. Rarely found in good
condition.

name: Lavasio Whirlfin
description:
A Lavasioth fin with sharp,
yet smooth edges. Prized by
weaponsmiths.

name: Lavasio Bladefin
description:
A Lavasioth fin with a
smooth luster. Boasts
top-quality sharpness.

name: Lavasio Razorfin
description:
A top-grade Lavasioth fin.
Barehanded contact carries
grave risks.

name: Cushy Hide
description:
A highly elastic Khezu hide.
Many hunters are captivated
by its strange texture.

name: Pure White Hide
description:
A pure white Khezu hide.
Strangely, its hue only
grows purer with use.

name: Pale Belly
description:
Fatty meat from a Khezu's
belly. Tempting to eat, but
better left alone.

name: Rathalos Direscl
description:
A sturdier Rathalos scale.
Highly sought after as a
crafting material.

name: Rathalos Hellscl
description:
Top-quality Rathalos scale.
A faint warmth can be felt
upon touch...

name: Rathalos Kingscl
description:
A scale whose magnificence
renders everyone speechless.
Befitting of its name.

name: Rathian Steelshl
description:
A patch of sturdy Rathian
scales. As tough as solid
steel.

name: Rathian Gleamshl
description:
The stout outer shell of a
Rathian. Even tougher than
the Steelshell.

name: Rathian Graceshl
description:
A sublime, rare outer shell.
Strong, with a remarkably
beautiful luster.

name: Crooked Horn
description:
A severely twisted Diablos
horn. Equipment forged from
it lasts a lifetime.

name: Brutal Horn
description:
A warped Diablos horn.
Difficult to process, but
exceptionally durable.

name: Sublime Horn
description:
A beautifully twisted horn.
Many hunters display it as
room decor.

name: Blango Crusher
description:
A quality Blangonga fang.
Stout and used to forge
even stronger equipment.

name: Blango Piercer
description:
A sublime Blangonga fang.
Fangs of this quality are
rarely ever found.

name: Blangonga Mauler
description:
A sharp fang etched with
countless scars. Befitting
of the fearsome Blangonga.

name: Hardcore Ticket
description:
A ticket used to initiate
Hardcore Mode on Quests.
Keep your wits about you!
