name: Snowflake Herb
description:
A plant with white flowers
that bloom like snowflakes
piled upon green leaves.

name: Sleet Herb
description:
A plant named for the way
its nectar drops from its
flowers, resembling sleet.

name: Popo Lily
description:
A plant named for its large
white flowers, reminiscent
of a Popo's tusks.

name: Slipperwort

The leaves that surround the

just like a woman's purse.

name: Flipped Herb
description:
A plant with leaves that
appear reversed, almost as
if turned inside out.

name: Parnet
description:
A crystal clear, orange
mineral. Extremely rare,
and therefore valuable.

description:
At first glance, this weird
mineral seems to be covered
with green mold.

name: Blue Moldstone
description:
At first glance, this weird
mineral seems to be covered
with blue mold.

name: Red Moldstone
description:
At first glance, this weird
mineral seems to be covered
with red mold.

name: Snowball Jewel
description:
A lump of white crystal with
a radial pattern. Looks just
like a snowball.

name: Icebug
description:
An insect that can live in
the coldest places, but
can't handle water at all.

name: Giaprey Monarch
description:
A butterfly named for the
Giaprey-like pattern on
its wings.

name: White Centipede
description:
A white centipede with legs
and feelers that are longer
than its body. Pretty swift.

name: Snow Spider
description:
A large spider known for
its soft hair, reminiscent
of fresh snow.

name: Slumberbug
description:
An insect that lives under-
ground and survives only a
few days above it.

name: Ragged Pouch
description:
A pouch that looks like it's
been chewed up by a monster.
Made of a good material.

name: Withered Bouquet
description:
This bunch of flowers has
seen much better days, but
is full of rare specimens.

name: Cracked Pot
description:
Many attempts have been
made to fix this pot, but
it remains cracked...

name: Pepperberry
description:
The go-to ingredient for
spice lovers. Not for the
faint of heart.

name: Hellfiery Herb
description:
A plant named for its large,
flame-shaped leaves. Despite
this, it's not hot at all.

name: Coalgrass
description:
A herb that looks like
burnt-out coal, but actually
contains a lot of water.

name: Fiery Herb
description:
A plant named for its flame
-shaped leaves. In spite of
this, it's not hot at all.

name: Toasty Bean
description:
A strange bean that feels
as if it had been cooked,
even when raw.

name: Truby
description:
A crystal clear red mineral.
Extremely rare and therefore
valuable.

name: RedBurdockStone
description:
A red stone with trace
amounts of metal. Shaped
like a cut burdock root.

name: Combustone
description:
A rock that combusts when
crushed. Dangerous, and
therefore hard to come by.

name: BlkBurdockStone
description:
A black stone with trace
amounts of metal. Shaped
like a cut burdock root.

name: BluBurdockStone
description:
A blue stone with trace
amounts of metal. Shaped

name: Swelterbug
description:

heat, such as that of lava.

name: Ioprey Monarch
description:
A butterfly named for the
Ioprey-like pattern on
its wings.

name: Basaltbug
description:
An insect named for its
lava rock-like body.

name: Blue Butterfly
description:
A butterfly named after the
blue eye-like pattern found

description:

name: Burnt Felvine
description:

description:

description:

an image on it that's cut

name: Stone Base
description:
A piece of stone tablet with
an image on it that's been
cut off at the top.

description:

highly valuable.

description:

description:

description:

the Draguros's dark thunder.

name: Draguros Wing+
description:

description:

description:

those who've triumphed over

name: Icicle Tiara
description:
世代が一巡するほどの時間を
かけて出来上がったつらら。
たくさん集めよう！

name: Millenial Snow
description:
千年もの間降り続けた雪を、
常温保存可能な塊にしたもの。
たくさん集めよう！

name: Permafrost Piece
description:
決して溶けることのない氷の
大地を削り取ったもの。
たくさん集めよう！

name: Iceberg Tip
description:
世界の果てにあると言われる
巨大な氷山のごくごく一部。
たくさん集めよう！

name: Reversible Stone
description:
表と裏の色がまったく異なる
不思議で珍しい天然の石。
たくさん集めよう！

name: Felyne Herb
description:
一見すると美味しそうだが、
とても食べられない味の植物。
たくさん集めよう！

name: False Whetstone
description:
刃こぼれさせて威力を高める
砥石。普通の刃には使用不可。
たくさん集めよう！

name: Black Platinum
description:
見る角度によって、表情を
大きく変える希少な金属。
たくさん集めよう！

name: N.Year Gift (Rabbit)
description:
A bag received on New Year's
Eve. Filled with something,
but definitely not zenny.

name: Shaka Fragment
description:
奇面族の奇妙な面のカケラ。
見たこともない素材らしく、
詳しいことは分からない。

name: Crimson Melody
description:
ある音を出すための楽譜。
音を視ることができる者曰く、
その音色は紅色らしい。

name: Azure Melody
description:
ある音を出すための楽譜。
音を視ることができる者曰く、
その音色は蒼色らしい。

name: 親愛なる仲間の力
description:
深い絆で結ばれている仲間達
が過ごした時間だけチカラに
なる！

name: Felyne Spirit
description:
教官見習ネコの熱い心意気。
持ち歩くと教官見習ネコの
言葉を思い出す。

name: Undried Hide
description:
常に濡れている軟らかい皮。
峡谷の崖の上に放置しても
乾くことがないらしい。

name: Christmas Song
description:
A song played in Mezeporta
Square at a certain time of
the year. Very evocative.

name: Large Stockings
description:
履く用途で使われることのな
い靴下。ベッドに吊るすとい
いことがあるらしい。

name: Passionate Stone
description:
A crystallized form of one's
passionate feelings. Could
this be THE day!?

name: Passionate Arrow
description:
A crystallized form of one's
passionate feelings. Could
this be THE day!?

name: 親愛なる仲間の印
description:
深い絆で結ばれている仲間達
へ贈られた印。
決して消えることはない。

name: Hunter's Motto
description:
アツく燃える狩人の座右の銘。
狩人にとって最も大切なもの
は何だと訴えかけてくる。

name: Shaka BBQ Spit
description:
A BBQ spit dropped by a
Shakalaka. Pretty dirty,
so it must be well-used.

name: Shakalaka Spike
description:
Part of a Shakalaka's mask.
Used to keep some kind of
tempo going...

name: Shakalaka Pouch
description:
An acorn-shaped pouch found
on a Shakalaka's hip. Its
lid refuses to come off.

name: Shining Star
description:
A star used to decorate a
large tree. Shines bright
day and night.

name: Frozen Fur
description:
凍てつくような冷たさを
感じさせる毛皮。
武具工房で加工してもらえる。

name: Steel Ore
description:
硬度の非常に高い石。
熟練の職人でないと加工は
難しい。

name: Beastly Claw
description:
とても獰猛なモンスターから
剥ぎ取った爪。触ることが
できないほど冷たい。

name: Beastly Fang
description:
とても獰猛なモンスターから
剥ぎ取った牙。触ることが
できないほど鋭い。

name: Pure White Fang
description:
状態の良い棘竜の牙。
高い硬度を活かし、
高性能な武具素材となる。

name: Tough Surspike
description:
状態の良い棘竜の棘。
高い強度を活かし、
高性能な武具素材となる。

name: Tough Red Horn
description:
状態の良い棘竜の角。
非常に強靭なため
高性能な武具素材となる。

name: Tough Heavyscl
description:
非常に珍しい形をした棘竜の
逆鱗。鋭い外縁を利用し、
高性能な武具素材となる。

name: Shotgun
description:
A never-before-seen weapon.
With some tweaking, it may
work against large monsters.

name: Pitchfork
description:
A farming tool. Unreliable
as a weapon, but if one were
to combine it...

name: Knife Set
description:
A set of large knives.
Combining them may create
a deadly weapon.

name: Gloves
description:
Boxing equipment. Worthless
against large monsters, but
their fit is outstanding.

name: Duct Tape
description:
An item capable of bonding
just about anything. Don't
overthink it, just use it!

name: DR2 Ticket H
description:
Instructions on forging the
Rider armor. Bring them to
the Smithy!

name: DR2 Ticket C

name: Basarios Rockshl
description:
A rugged Basarios shell.
Rare ores are sometimes
found within.

name: Basarios Firmshl
description:
A quality Basarios shell
whose toughness exceeds
that of a Steelshell.

name: Basarios Cragshl
description:
An immensely heavy shell
with a dignified air. Its
toughness is top-class.

name: Fine Rubberhide
description:
A highly elastic hide with a
pleasant texture. Its uses
vary from armor to bedding.

name: Prime Rubberhide
description:
A fine hide obtained from a
powerful Gypceros. Extremely
rare and valuable.

name: Gypcero Hardhead
description:
A rare, rock-like Gypceros
head. A priceless commodity
among Gypceros enthusiasts.

name: Teo Fiercehorn
description:
A symbol of Teostra's
ferocity. Its faint heat
can be felt nearby.

name: Teo Ravagehorn
description:
A horn carved from a brutal
Teostra. Highly valued as a
piece of art.

name: Teo Kaiserhorn
description:
A horn considered a badge
of honor, and the mark of
a true overlord.

name: Plesio Razorfin
description:
A sharp Plesioth fin.
Its hue changes slightly
with the viewing angle.

name: Plesio Bladefin
description:
When held up to the light, a
beautiful, geometric pattern
can be seen on its surface.

name: Plesio Beautifin
description:
A Plesioth fin whose luster
endures through time, never
losing its radiant sheen.

name: Hermitaur Pincer
description:
A giant Daimyo Hermitaur
pincer. Noted by its great
cutting ability.

name: Hermitaur Grasp
description:
A sturdy Daimyo Hermitaur
pincer. Bears the scars of
many hard-fought battles.

name: Hermitaur Vice
ダミー
description: ダミー

name: Tigrex Gouger
description:
A dully glowing claw, said
to grow sharper and stronger
with each kill.

name: Tigrex Ripper
description:
A claw carved from a brutal
Tigrex. Extremely rare, but
prized as a material.

name: Brnz Hypno Pelt
description:
A vibrant Hypnocatrice pelt.
Its soft fibers make it a
highly valuable material.

name: Vrmln Hypno Pelt
description:
Deep orange plumage from a
Hypnocatrice. Adds a touch
of elegance to hunter gear.

name: Prismatic Bezoar
description:
A mysterious stone with a
soft, pulsing glow. Its
beauty is outstanding.

name: ダミー
description: ダミー

name: Paria Piercer
description:
A sharp Pariapuria fang. Its
foul stench makes it rather
unpopular with artisans...

name: Paria Beautifin
description:
A fine Pariapuria fin. Very
slimy, and therefore hard
to obtain -- and craft...

name: ダミー
description: ダミー

name: F.Espi Grndspike
description:
A noxious Flaming Espinas
spike, said to make plants
wither and die...

name: ダミー
description: ダミー

name: Grenzebul Scale
description:
An ultramarine scale that
becomes more lustrous when
soaked in water.

name: Grenzebul Hide
description:
The hide from a Grenzebul's
abdomen. Highly elastic and
resistant to impacts.

name: Grenzebul Claw
description:
A claw that supports the
Grenzebul's body. Dense
and immensely heavy.

name: Grenzebul Horn
description:
The pride of the Grenzebul.
Hard and unbreakable, it is
extremely tough to craft.

name: Grenzebul Wing
description:
A wing with a dangerously
sharp blade-like edge. Take
extra care when carving.

name: Grenzebul Tail
description:
A tail lined with delicate
spikes. Improper handling
will cause them to crack.

name: Grenzebul Spike
description:
A spike found on the wings
and tail. As tough as the
claw but also razor sharp.

name: Grenzebul Scl+
description:
A quality Grenzebul scale.
Its pellucid blue hue has
an indescribable charm.

name: Grenzebul Hide+
description:
A quality hide carved from
the abdomen. Easy to craft
and popular among smithies.

name: Grenzebul Claw+
description:
A honed Grenzebul claw with
a dull luster. Said to have
torn apart countless prey.

name: Grenzebul Horn+
description:
The soul of the Grenzebul.
A half-hearted smithy stands
no chance against it.

name: Grenzebul Wing+
description:
Wings with distinctively
adhesive rippled tips that
are much harder to break.

name: Grenzebul Tail+
description:
A wondrous Grenzebul tail.
Its spikes shine with a
faint luster.

name: Grenzebul Spike+
description:
A reddish brown spike found
on the wings or the tail. As
large as an adult arm.

name: Grenzebul Cert.
description:
A certificate given only to
those who've triumphed over
the most arduous of hunts.

name: Training Jewel 1
description:
A special Decoration made
for training purposes. It
cannot be crafted.

name: Training Jewel 2
description:
A special Decoration made
for training purposes. It
cannot be crafted.

name: Training Jewel 3
description:
A special Decoration made
for training purposes. It
cannot be crafted.

name: Training Jewel 4
description:
A special Decoration made
for training purposes. It
cannot be crafted.

name: Feathrd Rockworm
description:
An insect found high in the
mountains. Its brown wings
make it look like a rock.

name: Tallroot Butterfly
description:
A yellow butterfly found in
the mountains, especially
during bad weather.

name: Barrelhopper
description:
A chubby insect that looks
like a barrel and lives for
a surprisingly long time.

name: Emerald Carabid
description:
A carnivorous insect with a
gleaming green body. Handle
with care!

name: Peach Butterfly
description:
A cute small butterfly with
a pink hue reminiscent of a
Congalala.

name: Arcstone
description:
A mineral with a curious
calming effect. Often used
as a charm.

name: Mountain Crystal
description:
A crystal that has become
mountain-shaped over time.
Very rare and precious.

name: Sugary Leaf
description:
A leaf that has become
encrusted with sweet nectar.
~C05(Account Item)

name: Rockpetal Herb
description:
A mountain plant with small
white flowers that were once
used to make a certain tea.

name: Reverie Bloom
description:
A mountain plant whose
flowers, like dreams, bloom
at dusk and wither at dawn.

name: Alpine Herb
description:
Its sharp leaves make this
plant dangerous to touch.
Used to make clothing.

name: Alpine Barbarea
description:
A plant with bright yellow
flowers that grows high
above sea level.

name: Porta Cookie
description:
A seasonal dessert made in
Mezeporta Square. Enjoyed by
children and adults alike.

name: Porta Chocolate
description:
A seasonal dessert made in
Mezeporta Square. Enjoyed by
children and adults alike.

name: Porta Candy
description:
A seasonal dessert made in
Mezeporta Square. Enjoyed by
children and adults alike.

name: E.Dragon Jaw
description:
The jaw of a powerful elder
dragon. Needless to say, it
is strong and valuable.

name: E.Dragon Webbing
description:
The membrane of a powerful
elder dragon. Carving it
requires utmost care.

name: Alpineshroom
description:
A sweet-smelling mushroom
found in the mountains. Has
a bitter taste.

name: Mellow Mackerel
description:
A fish that's found in every
season. Don't be fooled by
the name -- it bites!

name: Bulluk Horn
description:
A large Bulluk horn. Softer
than they look, these horns
excel at transferring heat.

name: Bulluk Hide
description:
The thick pelt of a Bulluk.
Stiff to the touch and an
excellent insulator.

name: Bulluk Head
description:
A large, immensely heavy
Bulluk head. Commonly worn
as headgear.

name: Alpelo Horn
description:
A dignified Alpelo horn.
The males display larger,
more robust projections.

name: Alpelo Hide
description:
The fluffy white fur of an

熱帯地方に生息する小さな紅
色の蝶。可憐に舞い飛ぶ姿か

description:
硬い甲殻を持ち、岩肌に張り
付いて暮らす珍しい虫。採掘
道具を使わないと獲れない。

name: Amnesia Herb
description:
すり潰して塗り薬として使わ
れてきた草。冬の小動物の貴
重な食料となっているようだ。

name: Goocoo Junk
description:
Junk (painstakingly?)
gathered by a Goocoo.
Try collecting it...?

name: Goocoo Charm
description:
An amulet prized by Goocoos.
Something good may happen if
you keep it in your pouch...

name: Auriol's Rice Ball
description:
A rice ball painstakingly
made by Auriol. "It's real
tasty!" ~C05(Supply Item)

name: Luring Arowana
description:
持っているだけでグークをお
びき寄せることができる不思
議な魚。~C05（精算アイテム）

name: Blissberry
description:
噛めば噛むほど美味しくなる
小粒の実。子供たちの間では
おやつとして大人気。

name: Inspiroshroom
description:
食べると頭が冴えると言われ

眠れなくなるので要注意。

name: Aurafern
description:
葉を占いに使用していたと
言われる草。すり潰して飲む
と美容に効くとの噂もある。

name: Gia Studs
description:
革をしっかりと留められる程

name: Gia Leather

頑丈な為、狩猟に向く。

name: Gia Crest
description:

人間には少し大きいので、
頭に乗せるのはやめておこう。

name: Gia Chain
description:

防具の部品を繋ぐのに最適。
装飾の意味もあるらしい？

name: Gia Belt
description:
頑丈な革製のベルト。
激しく動いても緩み難く、
狩猟防具に用いられる。

name: Blackfish

name: Razor Herb
description:

name: Fuzzy Herb
description:
A succulent plant with soft,

description:

name: Soft Shell
description:
A beautiful, flexible shell.

name: Rare Shell
description:

name: Pelican Ore
description:
An ore found in a shape that
encloses multiple minerals.

name: Black Pyroxene
description:
A black, crystal-like ore.

name: Palsanto Ore
description:
A hard-to-process ore that
looks just like a rock. Not
used in decorations.

name: Shovelhopper
description:
A grasshopper with a pair
of hoe-shaped shears on its
head. Difficult to catch.

name: Bellworm
description:
An insect with a bell-like
shape. It is said to produce

name: Shorefly
description:

name: Valiant Horn
description:

name: Fragrant Branch

name: Charming Fruit

name: Frostwood Sprout

Easy to lose sight of.

Must be picked at night.

name: Dazzling Lump

A rare ore reminiscent of a
pearl. Shines even brighter
when polished.

name: Wanderfish
description:
A capricious fish found in
numerous locales.

name: Stubborn Fish
description:
A fish whose habitat varies
greatly depending on season
and locale.

name: Red Glacebloom
description:
A plant with beautiful red
flowers. Quite tough despite
its appearance.

name: Snowfly
description:
An insect emitting a gentle,
pale glow. As for its body,
you'd best look away...

description:
A brittle type of quartz.
Often powdered and used
in processed goods.

name: Blue Seastone
description:
A stone with a clear blue
color, reminiscent of the
sea. Soothing to the eyes.

name: Snowshroom
description:
A cute mushroom reminiscent
of a princess clad in a pure
white dress. Quite elusive.

name: Evershroom
description:
A mushroom said to take ten
thousand years to mature.
Prized as a rare commodity.

name: Prime Salmon
description:
The finest of salmons.
Delicious when boiled,
grilled or eaten raw.

name: Anchor Tuna
description:
A giant fish found in very
cold regions. Resembles an
anchor from above.

name: Eternal Iceblock
description:
A highly pure, fist-sized
block of ice found while
mining. Won't melt easily.

name: Soapstone
description:
A smooth stone high in talc.
Commonly used to manufacture
cosmetics. ~C05(Account Item)

name: Special Mushroom
description:
Extremely tough, it can only
be eaten when prepared by a
specialist. ~C05(Account Item)

name: Mystic Halobloom
description:
A miraculous flower found
on Shakalakas. Incredibly
hard to come by.

name: Wyvern Prismtear
description:
An extremely precious tear
only wept by certain flying
wyverns. ~C05(Account Item)

name: Hard Dung
description:
Dung used to mark territory.
Also a high-quality fuel.
~C05(Account Item)

name: Rare Large Pearl
description:
A large pearl with a unique
color. Prized as a gemstone.
~C05(Account Item)

name: One-shot Binder
description:
Anti-monster ammo found on
the Exploration Vessel.
~C05(Supply Item)

A superior Kut-Ku bone.

refined elegance.

A sinister Yian Kut-Ku beak.
When struck, it produces an
unsettling sound.

name: Kut-Ku Bewitcher
description:
A bewitching Kut-Ku ear.
Its texture is strikingly
smooth.

name: Herm Primeshell
description:
A superior Daimyo Hermitaur
shell. It holds both power
and refined elegance.

name: Herm Shieldclaw
description:
A claw that specializes in
fending off predators. As
sturdy as a fortified wall.

name: Hermitaur Feeler
description:
A pair of Daimyo Hermitaur
antennae. Known for their
toughness and flexibility.

description:
The bone of a Pokaradon.
Its unique shape allows for
semi-aquatic life.

name: Pokaradon Claw
description:
When the monster strikes its
forelimbs, these metallic
claws resound with a clang.

name: Heroic Tusks
description:
A pair of stout tusks used
by the Pokaradon to defend
its herd.

name: Pokaradon Tear
description:
A crystal of ice formed
upon a Pokaradon's demise.
It shall never melt.

name: Pokaradon Tail
description:
The tail of a Pokaradon.
Its fin allows it to swim
through the waters.

name: Pokaradon Piel
description:
A thick Pokaradon pelt.
An indispensable part of
its harsh arctic life.

name: Prime Gem
description:
A crystal formed inside a
monster's body. Used as a
crafting material.

name: Gyp Magnapelt
description:
Tempered Gypceros hide.
A timeless material that
does not weather with age.

name: Sprint Extract
description:
A gross-looking fluid used
to provide the Gypceros with
nearly limitless stamina.

name: Gypcero Pyroxene
description:
A rare crystal formed inside
the Gypceros's crest. Shines
with a blinding light.

name: Conga Magnapelt
description:
Tempered Congalala pelt.
A timeless material that
does not weather with age.

name: Vivid Pelt
description:
Vibrant Congalala hair.
Beloved by hunters for its
striking beauty.

name: Conga Shredder
description:
A Congalala claw. Despite
the countless scars, its
edge remains razor sharp.

name: Falno Claw
description:
The claw of a Falnocatrice.
Better suited for dashing
rather than catching prey.

name: Falno Drypelt
description:
A vibrant Falnocatrice pelt.
Perpetually dry, it readily
produces static electricity.

name: Brilliant Quill
description:
A fluorescent tail feather.
Prized as a decoration and
coveted by the ladies.

name: Falno Voltpelt
description:
A Falnocatrice pelt with
an intense static charge.
Emits a crackling noise.

name: Falno Beak
description:
A resistive Falnocatrice
beak. Prized as a material
for thunder resistant armor.

name: Falno Tail
description:
A severed Falnocatrice tail.
Exceedingly rare and coveted
by bird wyvern fanatics.

A crystal formed inside a
monster's body. Used as a
crafting material.

It seems almost too lovely
to waste on equipment.

lifting the Basarios's
giant body.

description:
Head carved from a Basarios.
It weighs about as much as
a single Bulldrome.

name: Rath Glosscale
description:
A dazzling Rathian scale.
It seems almost too lovely
to waste on equipment.

name: Rathian Piercer

A helical spike found on
a Rathian's back and tail.
Extremely toxic.

name: Rath Direplate
description:
An eerily glowing Rathian
scale. Surrounded by an
ominous aura.

name: Ceana Glosshell

A dazzling Ceanataur shell.
It seems almost too lovely
to waste on equipment.

strength and sharpness.

Its dull gleam strikes fear
into the beholder.

razor sharp hairs help keep
predators at bay.

A small, sharp Hyujikiki
fang. Used to tear prey
apart.

name: Hyujikiki Spike

The largest and hardest
quills shot by Hyujikiki
are known as spikes.

name: Crimson Quill

A quill turned red due to
agitation. Named for the
color of its tip.

name: Hyujikiki Tail
description:
A Hyujikiki tail. Its tip is
made up of numerous hardened
hairs.

name: Hyujikiki Horn
description:
A uniquely shaped horn from
a Hyujikiki. It won't budge
under half-hearted attacks.

description:

小さいため用途が限られる。

とても大きな青水晶の塊。
